paper.title: Simthesizer: An Agent-Driven Simulation Framework for LLM Serving Systems
paper.abstract: System-level simulation is an essential tool for exploring the rapidly expanding design space of LLM serving systems, where real deployments remain costly and often infeasible. However, modern LLM serving now evolves faster than human-driven simulator development can track, and emerging workloads and mechanisms, from agentic workflows to disaggregated serving, no longer fit the monolithic simulation pipeline that existing simulators assume. Each new mechanism therefore demands an invasive rewrit

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 LLM serving 系统模拟器跟不上真实 serving 形态变化的问题。传统模拟器通常假设一次请求对应一条固定、单体的推理流水线，但现在的 serving 已经出现 agentic workflow、外部工具调用、动态分支、prefill/decode 解耦、speculative decoding、KV cache 量化、混合 Mamba/Transformer 等机制。每加入一种机制，旧模拟器往往需要改执行引擎，维护成本高，也难以校准真实系统行为。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对大模型系统研究有参考价值。它关注 serving simulator 的可扩展性和自动生成，这会影响推理优化方案的早期设计、容量规划和系统 trade-off 分析。对基座研究员的启发主要在两点：第一，未来 serving 工作负载不再是单次 decode，而是由多个模型调用、控制逻辑和工具调用组成的执行图；第二，用 LLM coding agent 扩展系统模拟器，需要先把底层系统抽象做得足够结构化，否则 agent 只是生成难以验证的胶水代码。
summary.technical_approach: Simthesizer 由两部分组成。第一部分是 composable simulator infrastructure，把 serving 工作流表示为 DAG。DAG 中不只包含 compute 和 communication 节点，也包含 routing、batch formation、control decision 等逻辑节点。这样新增机制时，可以通过组合控制组件和重连节点来表达，而不是重写一条固定 pipeline。第二部分是 Synthesizer agent，一个受 harness 约束的 coding agent。它把自然语言 feature request 细化成规格说明，映射到模拟器抽象，补齐缺失组件，然后用真实系统测量或参考证据验证结果。论文强调的区别在于：agent 并不是直接改一个大代码库，而是在预设接口、模块边界和验证 harness 内做“lowering”，降低生成错误和集成失败的概率。
summary.experiments: 论文实现了端到端框架，并用 OpenAI Codex 作为 Synthesizer agent 来扩展模拟器。评估覆盖 KV cache quantization、speculative decoding、hybrid Mamba model support 等 serving 特性。与 vLLM-based real system 对齐时，Simthesizer 的平均吞吐误差为 2.51%，而在现有模拟器上用相同 harness 扩展后的平均吞吐误差为 6.03%。仿真速度方面，在相同 LLM workloads 下，相比 LLMServingSim2.0 最高快 284.96×，相比 Vidur 最高快 23.19×。这些结果说明，论文的主要收益来自模拟器抽象的可组合性，而不只是 coding agent 的代码生成能力。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 fast evolution 和 non-monolithic serving 的问题定义，以及 Figure 1 对整体流程的说明。方法部分重点看 DAG 抽象、logical/control nodes、modular control layer 如何表达 serving 行为。实验部分优先看三类 feature extension 的验证方式、吞吐误差的计算方法，以及与 LLMServingSim2.0、Vidur 的速度对比。若关注 agent-assisted systems engineering，可以细看 harness 设计：它决定了 agent 生成代码是否可控、可测、可维护。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a practical gap in LLM serving simulation. Existing simulators often assume a fixed, monolithic inference pipeline, while modern serving increasingly consists of dynamic workflows: agentic requests, tool calls, routing decisions, disaggregated prefill/decode, speculative decoding, KV-cache quantization, and hybrid model architectures. Under the old simulator design, each new mechanism tends to require invasive changes to the execution engine.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is useful for researchers who care about the system side of large models. Serving workloads are becoming graph-structured rather than single-pass decoding jobs, and that changes how inference optimizations should be evaluated. The paper is also a concrete example of using coding agents in systems research: the useful part is not unconstrained code generation, but code generation constrained by clean abstractions, narrow interfaces, and validation harnesses.
summary_en.technical_approach: Simthesizer combines a composable simulator with an agent-driven lowering workflow. The simulator represents the full serving workflow as a DAG. Nodes include not only compute and communication operations, but also logical control decisions such as routing and batch formation. New mechanisms can then be expressed by composing control modules and reconnecting graph nodes, instead of rewriting a fixed simulation pipeline. The Synthesizer agent takes a natural-language feature request, refines it into a specification, maps it to the simulator abstractions, implements missing components, and validates the behavior against real-system measurements or reference evidence. The key design choice is to make the simulator extensible first, then use the coding agent within that structure.
summary_en.experiments: The implementation evaluates extensions for KV-cache quantization, speculative decoding, and hybrid Mamba model support. OpenAI Codex is used as the coding agent under the same harnesses for Simthesizer and existing simulators. Against a vLLM-based real system, Simthesizer reaches an average throughput error of 2.51%, compared with 6.03% for extensions built on existing simulators. On identical LLM workloads, it reports up to 284.96× faster simulation than LLMServingSim2.0 and up to 23.19× faster simulation than Vidur. The main empirical message is that composable simulator structure improves both extensibility and accuracy.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Start with the problem setup in the introduction, especially the distinction between fast evolution and non-monolithic serving. Then read the simulator abstraction: the DAG representation, logical nodes, and modular control layer. In the evaluation, focus on how the three serving features are integrated and how throughput error is measured against the vLLM-based system. If interested in coding-agent infrastructure, read the harness design carefully; it is the part that makes agent-generated simulator extensions testable rather than ad hoc.

recommendation.zh: 读方法不读宣传：动态图抽象可能适合 internal serving what-if 模拟，agent 生成部分要看约束是否足够硬。
recommendation.en: Read the method, not the pitch: the dynamic-graph abstraction may help internal serving what-if simulation, but the agent-generated code needs hard constraints.

paper.title: NeuroPrefetcher: Storage-Aware Sparse LLM Inference via Delta Prefetching
paper.abstract: Deploying large language models on edge devices is increasingly limited by a widening gap between model size and available memory. Existing approaches such as quantization, smaller models, and offloading can raise the effective memory limit, but they still assume that the model can be compressed or partitioned to fit within some budget. We target the harder model-exceeds-memory setting, in which the model remains larger than resident memory throughout execution and storage becomes an active sour

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个比常见 edge LLM 部署更难的设定：模型在整个推理过程中始终大于可驻留内存，因而 NVMe/存储不再只是冷备份，而是解码关键路径上的主动权重层级。问题不只是“如何做稀疏推理”，而是“在自回归逐 token 解码里，如何利用跨 token 的稀疏激活时间局部性，提前知道下一步需要哪些 MLP 行权重，并且只搬运新增的那一小部分”。作者观察到相邻 token 的活跃神经元高度重叠，约 82–85% 会延续到下一 token；如果系统仍按 demand paging 或逐层临时判定来取数，就会把大量本可复用的权重反复放到 I/O 临界路径上，导致 CPU 长时间阻塞、GPU 空转。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接启发不在预训练算法本身，而在“稀疏激活是否真的能转化为端到端系统收益”这个问题上。很多稀疏工作停留在 FLOPs 或单步权重读取减少，但这里把关注点推进到 storage-backed inference 的真实瓶颈：跨 token 的增量权重搬运。这个视角对未来做稀疏 MoE、激活选择、动态子网络、甚至训练期的结构化稀疏设计都有参考价值，因为它提醒我们，决定系统收益的不是某一步有多稀疏，而是连续步骤之间的工作集变化率有多小。若一个稀疏方法能让 active set 稳定，系统就能靠 delta prefetch 获得额外收益；若 active set 抖动很大，理论稀疏度未必能兑现。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是 predictive delta prefetching。第一步是尽早预测后续层的稀疏激活。作者不是像 DejaVu 一类方法那样到达某层时再预测该层活跃神经元，而是在 layer 0 之后，用一个单独的 GPU 驻留预测器，基于早期 token 特征一次性预测所有下游 MLP 层的 active-neuron mask。这样 sparse layer 的 I/O 计划会在真正执行这些层之前就可得，给 NVMe 预取留出时间窗口。第二步是把预测转成“增量搬运”决策。运行时为每层维护当前已驻留的权重行集合，将预测得到的下一 token 活跃集合与 resident set 做差，只从 NVMe 拉取 incoming delta，而不是重新准备整套 sparse rows。这个设计利用了相邻 token 高重叠的事实，把 I/O 成本从‘当前需要多少’改写成‘相对上一步新增多少’。第三步是面向 Jetson 这类统一内存平台处理一致性问题。作者指出 direct I/O 可能绕过 CPU cache coherence，导致 GPU 看到陈旧数据，因此运行时采用 cache-coherent staging path，再把 sparse rows 送入 GPU 执行缓冲。第四步是 memory-adaptive dense/sparse split：把有限 GPU 内存划分为完全常驻的 dense prefix 和采用活跃行缓冲的 sparse suffix。内存宽松时保留更多前层为 dense，减少调度复杂度；内存紧张时扩大 sparse suffix，提高可运行模型规模。这个设计不是单纯做层切分，而是在“早层常驻带来的稳定收益”和“后层稀疏带来的容量扩展”之间做动态折中。
summary.experiments: 从全文可见，作者首先用系统 profiling 说明问题确实存在：在 Jetson AGX Orin 上运行 Mistral-7B、mem=14G 的场景里，解码阶段每秒约 11,453 次 major page faults，CPU 有 77% 时间阻塞在 I/O，GPU 平均利用率只有 3%。这组数字很关键，因为它说明瓶颈不是算力而是反应式取权重。方法有效性的前提观察也给了明确量化：相邻 token 的 MLP 活跃神经元有约 82–85% 延续。实验主线应包括三部分：一是预测器精度与 lookahead 是否足够早；二是 delta prefetch 相比 demand paging、普通 sparse runtime、以及不做增量比较的预取策略，在 token latency、吞吐和存储读取量上的收益；三是 dense/sparse split 在不同内存预算下的最优点。引言已明确对比对象包括 llama.cpp 的 mmap+demand paging、PowerInfer、LLM in a Flash、Neuralink 等思路。就阅读价值而言，最该关注的不是单一平均加速比，而是作者如何拆解 I/O wait、GPU utilization、delta size、resident reuse miss 这些系统指标，并证明收益来自‘跨 token 工作集稳定性’而不是仅仅来自更高稀疏率。当前给出的全文片段没有完整结果表，因此不宜编造具体加速倍数；但从问题设定和实验组织看，这是一篇系统论文，关键证据应落在 page fault 降低、NVMe 读取减少、端到端 decode latency 改善，以及在更低内存预算下仍可运行较大模型。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议先看 Introduction 和问题 profiling，确认它解决的是 model-exceeds-memory 而不是普通 offloading。然后重点看方法部分里三个点：全层一次性稀疏预测器、resident set 与 delta 计算、以及 cache-coherent staging path。这三处决定它和已有 sparse inference 系统的区别。实验部分建议优先找四类图表：1）相邻 token active set overlap 的统计；2）不同方法的 I/O stall / page fault / GPU 利用率；3）不同内存预算下 dense/sparse split 的性能曲线；4）预测误差对端到端收益的敏感性。预计 20–30 分钟可以抓住主线。如果要深挖，值得想两个问题：其一，这种时间局部性在不同架构、不同 prompt 分布、不同 sparsifier 下是否稳定；其二，训练期能否显式正则 active set 的时间平滑性，让部署系统更容易做 delta prefetch。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a harder deployment regime than standard edge LLM inference: the model remains larger than resident memory throughout decoding, so storage is no longer a passive cold tier but an active source of weights on the critical path. The real question is not merely how to run sparse MLPs, but how to exploit temporal locality in autoregressive decoding so that the system can know the next token’s sparse working set early enough and fetch only the newly needed weight rows. The key empirical observation is that adjacent tokens reuse most active MLP neurons, with roughly 82–85% persistence from one token to the next. If the runtime still relies on demand paging or layer-local reactive sparsity decisions, it repeatedly exposes avoidable weight movement to the I/O critical path, leaving the CPU stalled and the GPU underutilized.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to foundation-model research is indirect but real. The paper sharpens an important systems question: when does activation sparsity translate into end-to-end gains under realistic memory pressure? Many sparsity papers report fewer FLOPs or fewer weights touched per step, but this work argues that in storage-backed inference the decisive quantity is the change in sparse working set across consecutive tokens. That perspective matters for sparse MLPs, MoE routing, dynamic subnetworks, and even training-time sparsity design. A sparse method with stable active sets can unlock additional systems gains through delta prefetching; a method with high token-to-token churn may look sparse on paper yet fail to reduce critical-path I/O.
summary_en.technical_approach: The central idea is predictive delta prefetching. First, the system predicts downstream sparsity early. Instead of using per-layer predictors that reveal a layer’s active set only when execution reaches that layer, NeuroPrefetcher runs a single GPU-resident predictor after layer 0 and predicts active-neuron masks for all downstream MLP layers in one shot from early-token features. This creates a lookahead I/O schedule before sparse execution begins. Second, the runtime converts predictions into movement decisions. For each layer it tracks which weight rows are already resident, compares that resident set with the predicted active set for the next token, and fetches only the incoming delta from NVMe. This reframes the I/O cost from “how many rows are needed now” to “how many new rows are needed relative to the previous token.” Third, the implementation addresses a platform-specific coherence issue on Jetson-style unified-memory systems: direct I/O can bypass CPU cache coherence and expose stale data to the GPU, so sparse rows are routed through a cache-coherent staging path before execution. Fourth, the runtime uses a memory-adaptive dense/sparse split. Limited GPU memory is divided between a fully resident dense prefix and a sparse suffix with active-row buffers. With more memory, more early layers stay dense; with less memory, the sparse suffix expands to preserve model executability. The design is therefore not just sparse execution, but a coordinated predictor-runtime-memory policy.
summary_en.experiments: The most important evidence starts with system profiling. On a Jetson AGX Orin running Mistral-7B with a 14G memory setting, decoding triggers about 11,453 major page faults per second; the CPU spends 77% of its time blocked on I/O, while the GPU averages only 3% utilization. This establishes that the bottleneck is reactive weight movement rather than arithmetic throughput. The enabling observation is also quantified clearly: around 82–85% of active MLP neurons persist across adjacent tokens. The experimental story appears to have three main parts: predictor quality and lookahead timing; end-to-end gains of delta prefetching over demand paging and prior sparse runtimes; and the trade-off induced by the dense/sparse split under different memory budgets. The introduction names relevant baselines such as llama.cpp with mmap plus demand paging, PowerInfer, LLM in a Flash, and Neuralink-style placement ideas. For a reader, the most useful results are likely not a single average speedup number, but the breakdowns showing reduced page faults, lower I/O stall time, smaller NVMe traffic, better GPU utilization, and improved decode latency. The provided full-text excerpt does not include the final result tables, so it would be unsafe to invent exact speedup values.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the introduction and the profiling figure to verify the target regime: this is model-exceeds-memory inference, not ordinary offloading. Then focus on three technical pieces: the all-downstream sparsity predictor, the resident-set versus delta computation, and the cache-coherent staging path. Those are the parts that distinguish the system from earlier sparse runtimes. In the experiments, prioritize four kinds of plots: token-to-token active-set overlap, I/O stall and page-fault reductions, performance versus memory budget for the dense/sparse split, and sensitivity to prediction error. Around 20–30 minutes should be enough to capture the main contribution. If reading more deeply, two follow-up questions are worth keeping in mind: whether this temporal locality is stable across architectures, prompts, and sparsification methods, and whether training could explicitly regularize active-set smoothness to make deployment-time delta prefetching easier.

recommendation.zh: 只看“跨token激活局部性=可预取的delta集合”这条观察和系统实现细节；收益是否稳健取决于稀疏门控与工作负载分布。
recommendation.en: Read for the core observation—token-to-token activation locality enables delta prefetching—and the system details; real value hinges on robustness across sparsity gating and workload distributions.

paper.title: Benchmarking LLM Serving Systems for Agentic AI Workloads with XPerf
paper.abstract: We present XPerf, a benchmarking framework that load-tests LLM serving systems with diverse agentic AI workloads. It provides detailed profiling of the serving system and hardware, enabling users to identify performance bottlenecks introduced by agentic workloads. Benchmarking LLM serving systems under agentic workloads is challenging - agentic applications rely on nondeterministic LLM outputs to guide their control flow; therefore, workload patterns vary unpredictably from run to run. XPerf min

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是：如何在 agentic AI 负载下，稳定、可复现地评测 LLM serving 系统。难点不在单次请求，而在 agent 的控制流由模型输出驱动，天然带有分支和反馈；同一个用户请求，哪怕随机种子固定，也可能因为解码细微差异走出完全不同的执行图，导致 LLM 调用次数、每次调用的输入输出长度、工具调用穿插方式都显著变化。论文给出的直接证据是：在相同请求上重复运行 mini-SWE-agent + gpt-oss-120b，平均 LLM 调用次数可相差 70%。这意味着如果还用传统的独立请求或多轮对话压测 serving，测到的不是 agent 真实负载，而是一个被大幅简化后的代理问题。
summary.importance: 对基座研究员来说，这篇论文不是在改预训练算法，但它补上了一个很实际的接口：训练侧越来越关心长上下文、prefix cache、KV cache、tool-use、multi-call reasoning，这些能力最后都要落到 serving 系统上，而 agent workload 正是把这些因素同时放大的场景。XPerf 的价值主要有三点。第一，它把“agent workload 不可复现”这个长期妨碍系统比较的问题，转成了可追踪、可合成、可回放的工程对象。第二，它把评测粒度从端到端 latency 往下拆到 execution graph、cache 命中、token throughput、GPU tensor core / memory bandwidth 利用率，便于定位瓶颈。第三，它提醒预训练和后训练研究者：如果模型能力演化带来更复杂的调用图，serving 侧的真实成本结构会变，单看 tokens/s 已经不够。就研究量级看，它更像一套高质量 benchmark / instrumentation 基础设施，而不是新的建模范式。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 trace → execution graph → workload synthesis → deterministic replay → profiling 这一整条链路。

1. 通用 tracing。XPerf 支持对 LangChain、LangGraph 等常见 agent 框架做无侵入或低侵入埋点；对自建 agent 只需很少注释。它记录的不只是 LLM 请求本身，还包括工具调用及其时间信息。

2. 执行图重建。论文用基于 time-span tree 的分析方法，从 traces 中恢复 LLM call、tool call 及其依赖关系，得到 execution graph。这个设计比简单按时间顺序回放更合理，因为 agent 负载里存在并发、等待工具返回、条件分支等结构，只有显式依赖图才能保留真实调度约束。

3. 工作负载合成。作者没有把 benchmark 限定为“原样回放历史 trace”，而是允许在 execution graph 之上改变请求到达模式，构造 online serving、offline batch inference、fixed-concurrency 等不同场景。这一点很关键，因为系统研究需要控制 arrival process，才能比较调度器、batching、cache 策略在不同负载区间的行为。

4. 可复现回放。为保证 replay fidelity，XPerf 对每个 LLM call 提交记录下来的精确 input token IDs，而不是重新 tokenize 文本；这样可以保留 prefix cache 命中行为。必要时还可以强制 serving engine 解码记录过的 output tokens，避免因为模型输出偏移而改变后续控制流。回放时还遵守 execution graph 的依赖顺序，并把工具调用时长纳入时间轴，因此即便被测 serving engine 与 tracing 时不同，负载形态仍尽量贴近原始应用。

5. 细粒度 profiling。系统层面报告 KV cache usage、prefix cache hit rate、token throughput 等；硬件层面报告 GPU tensor core 利用率、memory bandwidth 利用率等。作者强调 profiler 开销很低，避免 benchmark 本身扭曲结果。

和已有工作相比，区别主要在两点：一是它不是只测独立请求，也不是只做 agent 任务完成率；二是它公开、可扩展，并且把“非确定性 agent 行为”通过 trace replay 固定下来，而不是接受 run-to-run variance 作为噪声。
summary.experiments:
论文用 8 个较流行的 agentic 应用做 workload，覆盖 deep research、coding、Q&A 和通用 assistant。实验里最关键的结果有三类。

第一类是 replay 准确性。XPerf 在 isolated request 和 concurrent request 两种设置下，端到端请求时延的 mean absolute percentage error 都低于 3%。这说明 trace replay 足够接近真实执行，可用于系统比较，而不是只做粗略模拟。

第二类是 workload variance 的量化。作者展示了真实 agent 运行的高方差：同一请求重复运行，execution graph 会明显变化，前文给出的代表性数字是 mini-SWE-agent + gpt-oss-120b 上 LLM 调用次数平均差异 70%。这组结果支撑了整篇论文的动机：如果没有 replay，很多 serving 对比实验的方差会大到难以解释。

第三类是系统瓶颈分析能力。借助 XPerf，作者可以把 agent 应用的端到端 latency 拆成更细的组成部分，并结合 prefix cache hit、KV cache 占用、token throughput、GPU 计算与带宽利用率来解释性能差异。摘要截断后没有给出全部数值，但从正文结构看，重点不在宣称某个 serving engine 绝对更快，而在展示 XPerf 能稳定复现实验，并把瓶颈定位到 cache、调度、并发或硬件利用率层面。

如果从预训练研究者关心的角度看，最有信息量的不是某个具体系统排名，而是：agent workload 会显著改变 prefix reuse、请求长度分布和并发模式，因此很多在标准 chat benchmark 上看起来合理的 serving 优化，在 agent setting 下未必成立。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，重点抓方法链路和评测设计，不必在实现细节上停太久。建议顺序如下。

1. 先看 Introduction 和 Figure 3 一类展示 workload variance 的图，理解为什么 agent benchmark 不能直接沿用传统 serving 压测。
2. 再看 §3.3 到 §3.7，这是整篇最核心的部分：tracing、execution graph 构建、workload synthesis、replay、profiling。这里要重点看作者如何保证 prefix cache 行为和依赖顺序不被破坏。
3. 接着看 §5.3 的 replay fidelity，确认 benchmark 是否真的可信；低于 3% 的时延误差是这套方法成立的基础。
4. 最后看 §5.4 及后续 case studies，关注它如何把端到端 latency 拆解到 serving 和硬件指标上。

预计 25–35 分钟可以抓住主要内容。如果只关心是否值得纳入自己的系统评测栈，读完方法部分和 replay accuracy 即可；如果关心 agent workload 对 cache / batching 策略的影响，再补读案例分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a concrete systems problem: how to benchmark LLM serving under agentic workloads in a reproducible way. The difficulty is that agent execution graphs are induced by model outputs. Small decoding differences can change whether the agent calls a tool, branches, reflects, or stops, which then changes the number of LLM calls, prompt lengths, output lengths, and dependency structure. The paper shows this is not a minor effect: running the same request twice with mini-SWE-agent and gpt-oss-120b yields about 70% variation in the number of LLM calls on average. That makes conventional serving benchmarks, which assume independent requests or simple multi-turn chats, a poor proxy for real agent traffic.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it matters for foundation-model researchers because it sharpens the interface between model capability and deployment cost. As models become better at tool use, long-context reasoning, and multi-step planning, serving behavior is shaped less by single-call throughput and more by execution-graph structure, cache reuse, and concurrency patterns. XPerf contributes a usable benchmark and instrumentation layer for that regime. Its main value is threefold: it turns nondeterministic agent behavior into a replayable workload; it exposes system and hardware counters that explain latency rather than just reporting it; and it provides a public, extensible setup instead of a proprietary trace collection. The contribution is best understood as benchmark infrastructure with strong methodological discipline, not as a new modeling idea.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method is a full pipeline: trace collection, execution-graph reconstruction, workload synthesis, deterministic replay, and low-overhead profiling.

1. Application-agnostic tracing. XPerf instruments popular agent frameworks such as LangChain and LangGraph with minimal friction, and supports lightweight annotations for custom agents. It records both LLM calls and tool calls, including timing information.

2. Execution-graph construction. Rather than replaying requests as a flat sequence, XPerf reconstructs dependencies among LLM calls and tool invocations using a time-span-tree-based analysis. This matters because agent workloads contain waiting, branching, and sometimes parallel structure. A dependency graph preserves the scheduling constraints that actually shape serving behavior.

3. Workload synthesis. XPerf does not stop at replaying historical traces. It can alter request arrival patterns over the reconstructed execution graphs to emulate online serving, offline batch inference, and fixed-concurrency settings. This makes the framework useful for controlled systems studies, where arrival processes must be varied independently of application logic.

4. Reproducible replay. For each LLM call, XPerf submits the exact recorded input token IDs, not just the raw text, so prefix-cache behavior is preserved. It can also force the serving engine to decode the recorded output tokens, preventing output drift from changing downstream control flow. Replay respects dependency order in the execution graph and accounts for tool-call durations, so the workload remains realistic even when the target serving engine differs from the one used during trace collection.

5. Fine-grained profiling. XPerf reports serving metrics such as KV-cache usage, prefix-cache hit rate, and token throughput, and hardware metrics such as tensor-core utilization and memory-bandwidth utilization. The profiler is designed to add negligible overhead.

Relative to prior work, the distinction is clear: it is neither an agent-quality benchmark nor a standard serving microbenchmark. Its central idea is to freeze the stochastic control flow of agent applications into a reproducible systems workload.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation uses eight agentic applications spanning deep research, coding, Q&A, and general-purpose assistance. The most important results fall into three buckets.

First, replay fidelity. XPerf achieves below 3% mean absolute percentage error in end-to-end request latency for both isolated and concurrent requests. That is the key validation result: if replay were not faithful, the rest of the benchmark would be hard to trust.

Second, workload variance in native agent runs. The paper quantifies how unstable agent execution can be without replay. The headline example is the roughly 70% average variation in the number of LLM calls for the same request under mini-SWE-agent with gpt-oss-120b. This result justifies the entire benchmark design.

Third, bottleneck diagnosis. With replay fixed, XPerf can decompose end-to-end latency and relate it to prefix-cache hits, KV-cache occupancy, token throughput, and GPU compute or bandwidth utilization. The paper’s emphasis is not on claiming one serving engine wins universally, but on showing that the framework can localize where performance is lost under agent-style traffic.

For a foundation-model audience, the useful takeaway is that agent workloads materially change prefix reuse, request-length distributions, and concurrency structure. Optimizations that look effective on standard chat-style benchmarks may behave differently once execution graphs become deeper and more irregular.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. Focus on the benchmark design, not implementation minutiae.

Start with the introduction and the figure that quantifies run-to-run variance in agent execution. That establishes why standard serving benchmarks are insufficient.

Then read Sections 3.3 to 3.7 carefully. Those sections contain the real contribution: tracing, execution-graph reconstruction, workload synthesis, replay, and profiling. Pay special attention to how the framework preserves prefix-cache behavior and dependency order.

Next, check the replay-fidelity section. The sub-3% latency error is the main evidence that the methodology works.

Finally, read the case studies that break down end-to-end latency into serving and hardware metrics. The value there is diagnostic structure, not leaderboard ranking.

About 25 to 35 minutes should be enough to extract the main ideas. If your interest is only whether to adopt it as a benchmark harness, the method section plus replay validation is sufficient.

recommendation.zh: 推理系统论文，但和 agent-era 模型训练目标有关；只看 workload taxonomy 和 replay 误差分析。
recommendation.en: A serving paper with relevance to agent-era model design; skim the workload taxonomy and replay-error analysis.

summary.core_problem: 解决在缺少可编辑高层源码时，如何直接对已编译 AMD GPU kernel 二进制做安全、可验证的自动优化。
summary.importance: 这是代码智能与系统优化交叉工作。对预训练研究员的直接价值不在 kernel 本身，而在 agent 处理长时程程序编辑、验证闭环和 correctness-gated search 的设计。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 AsmEvo：从 AMDGPU code object 恢复可重组装表示，基于长时程 agent 提议汇编级编辑，重建保持 ABI 兼容的优化对象，并仅在与原始二进制差分验证通过后接受候选。系统结合 metadata-aware rebuilding、profiling-guided hot-window editing、correctness-gated timing 和保守的 in-place patch fallback。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses how to safely optimize compiled AMD GPU kernels when editable high-level source is unavailable and the deployed binary is the only behavioral oracle.
summary_en.importance: This sits at the intersection of coding agents and systems optimization. Its value to pretraining researchers is not the kernel domain itself, but the long-horizon program-editing loop with strict verification and correctness-gated search.
summary_en.technical_approach: AsmEvo reconstructs a reassemblable representation from an AMDGPU code object, lets a long-horizon agent propose assembly-level edits, rebuilds an ABI-preserving optimized object, and accepts candidates only after differential verification against the original binary. The system combines metadata-aware rebuilding, profiling-guided hot-window editing, correctness-gated timing, and conservative fallback patching.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not expose full benchmark numbers, but the setting is stricter than source-level CUDA/Triton optimization because the deployed binary is the only oracle. If the full paper shows robust speedups across diverse kernels, it becomes a solid case study for agent-plus-verifier loops; otherwise it is mainly an engineering system.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutions include AMD and Southern University of Science and Technology. The AMD affiliation gives the work some credibility in real GPU-kernel optimization settings.

recommendation.zh: 和 pretrain 不直接相关，但 verifier-gated long-horizon editing 这套闭环值得借到 coding agent；只看系统设计图和验证协议，性能表别过度外推。
recommendation.en: Not directly a pretraining paper, but the verifier-gated long-horizon editing loop is worth borrowing for coding agents; read the system diagram and validation protocol, not just the speedup table.

paper.title: Cascade: Exploiting SLO-Aware latency budget for fair and high goodput LLM inference serving
paper.abstract: The reasoning and agentic capabilities of large language models have expanded the range of applications they support, from short interactive exchanges to long, compute-heavy requests. LLM serving platforms today define response-latency service-level objectives, even though requests within the same service can differ by orders of magnitude in input length, generation length, execution cost, and the availability of reusable KV-cache state. As a result, requests governed by the same service level o

summary.core_problem: LLM serving 请求在输入长度、生成长度、计算成本和 KV-cache 可复用性上差异很大，但平台常用同一个响应延迟 SLO 管理，导致调度时无法区分真实紧急度。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 LLM serving 系统创新：把 SLO 与预测剩余执行时间的差值定义为 per-request latency budget，并据此做动态调度。它不推进预训练算法，但对理解长请求、agentic workload、KV-cache 复用下的在线系统瓶颈有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Cascade，持续估计每个请求的 latency budget，估计信号包括请求特征、KV-cache 状态和当前系统负载。与只看统一 SLO 或静态优先级的调度不同，Cascade 根据剩余预算动态更新请求紧急度，目标是在满足 SLO 的同时提升 goodput 和公平性。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体集群规模、模型类型、trace、baseline 或提升数字。可确认实验应比较 Cascade 与现有 LLM serving 调度策略在 SLO 达成率、goodput、公平性、长短请求混合负载和 KV-cache 复用场景下的表现。
summary.authors_note: 作者列表包括 Rodrigo Fonseca 和 Esha Choukse 等系统研究者；仅凭给定信息无法确认机构。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM serving requests vary widely in prompt length, generation length, execution cost, and reusable KV-cache state, yet platforms often assign the same latency SLO to all requests in a service.
summary_en.importance: This is an LLM serving-system contribution. It introduces per-request latency budget—the gap between a request's SLO and predicted remaining service time—and uses it for scheduling. It does not change pretraining methods, but it is directly useful for understanding online bottlenecks under long, agentic, and KV-cache-heavy workloads.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes Cascade, which continuously estimates each request's latency budget from request features, KV-cache state, and current system load. Instead of treating a shared SLO as shared urgency, Cascade dynamically updates scheduling priority based on remaining headroom to improve goodput and fairness under SLO constraints.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide cluster size, model choices, traces, baselines, or numerical improvements. The expected evaluation compares Cascade against existing LLM serving schedulers on SLO attainment, goodput, fairness, mixed short/long workloads, and KV-cache reuse scenarios.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes systems researchers such as Rodrigo Fonseca and Esha Choukse; affiliations cannot be confirmed from the provided information.

recommendation.zh: 预训练研究员可只看调度信号设计：KV-cache 状态进入 SLO 预算，是评估长上下文和 agent workload 成本时该借的系统视角。
recommendation.en: Skim the scheduling signal design: putting KV-cache state into the SLO budget is the systems lens to borrow for long-context and agentic workload cost analysis.

paper.title: TokTier: Exact Stateful Tokenization for Agentic LLM Serving
paper.abstract: LLM serving systems cache prompt KV state, yet most front ends still re-tokenize the full request text on every call. The cost lands on coding agents, which resubmit a long transcript after each small tool result, and reuse is hard because even a short append can change token boundaries near the end of the previous sequence. summary.core_problem: TokTier 解决的是 agentic LLM serving 中一个容易被低估的前端瓶颈：KV prefix cache 已经避免了模型重复处理长前缀，但 tokenizer 仍然在每次请求时重新扫描完整 transcript。编码 agent 的请求模式会放大这个问题，因为大多数调用只是向已有会话追加一小段工具结果，但请求文本会携带完整历史。难点在于 tokenization 不是简单可拼接的，追加少量文本也可能改变旧文本尾部的 token 边界，因此不能只按 byte prefix 复用旧 token IDs。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对长上下文、agent serving 和 tokenizer 工程有明确启发。它说明当 prompt-cache 命中率接近 0.99 时，tokenization 可以从 TTFT 的 10% 上升到 64%，成为前端主要延迟来源。对基座模型研究者来说，价值在两个方面：第一，tokenizer 不只是离线预处理组件，它会影响长上下文和 agent workload 的 serving 成本；第二，tokenizer 的“精确等价”约束很硬，任何近似、启发式 overlap 或非等价 GPU tokenizer 都可能改变模型输入和 cache key。
summary.technical_approach: TokTier 将请求分成两条路径。对于会话 continuation，它保存每个 live session 的 token IDs 和 byte spans。新请求到来时，只重新 tokenize 新增文本加旧上下文的一个小后缀，然后把新 token 记录和缓存 token 记录进行比对。只有通过 stable boundary check 时才 splice 缓存前缀；这个检查用于证明 pre-tokenizer 不会跨过该边界观察更远文本。如果检查失败，窗口会逐步扩大，最后退回完整 reference tokenizer，因此失败只增加延迟，不改变输出。对于没有可复用前缀的 full-context 请求，TokTier 给 GPT-family tokenizer 构造了等价的 GPU tokenization 路径。它把输入分解成 maximal character-class runs，用 run 内位置、邻近文本和 run-level summaries 推导 regex pre-tokenization 的 piece starts，从而绕开通常的 leftmost-first sequential regex scan。之后使用 GPU BPE pipeline 编码 pieces；短片段仍走 CPU。系统还使用 content-addressed tokenizer registry 和后台 verifier，对线上请求采样并与 reference implementation 比较，避免执行历史相关 bug 破坏精确性。
summary.experiments: 论文报告了两类 workload 特征和系统结果。数据侧，来自两个 agent ecosystem 的 153,951 次调用显示，median append 约 1.4K characters，只有 1.0–3.6% 的调用是新会话或重建会话；fleet-level prompt-cache hit rate 为 94.1%，上下文可达 86K 到 123K tokens，甚至到百万字符级。正确性侧，作者覆盖 17 个 tokenizer families，使用 version-pinned artifacts；差分测试包括 synthetic/adversarial inputs、12.4TB real-text corpus 全量 sweep，以及 93,000+ replayed agent steps，测试配置中没有发现与 reference tokenizer 的 divergence。性能侧，incremental repair 在 100K 到 3M characters 范围内保持 0.5–1.1ms；在 1M characters 上比最强 cache-based alternative 快 2.1×，在 2M 上快 3.0×。full-context GPU path 达到 3.8–4.7GB/s，1M-character context 编码耗时 0.87ms，比文中对比的最快已发表 CPU 方法低 23.4×。接入 vLLM 后，在 loaded regimes 下 median TTFT 降低 16–34%，在记录的 burst arrivals 下 P99 降低 23%。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20–30 分钟。优先看 workload measurement 和 component sweep，那里解释了为什么 tokenizer 会在高 cache hit 场景下变成瓶颈。然后看 tokenization non-compositionality 的例子和 stable boundary check，这是论文最关键的正确性设计。GPU tokenizer 部分适合关注 GPT-family regex 如何被 run decomposition 等价改写；这部分对设计新 tokenizer 或评估 tokenizer serving 成本有参考意义。实验部分重点看 differential testing 覆盖范围、增量 repair 延迟曲线、vLLM end-to-end TTFT 结果。可以跳过部分工程实现细节，除非正在做 serving 前端或 tokenizer runtime。

summary_en.core_problem: TokTier addresses a front-end bottleneck in agentic LLM serving. Prefix KV caching lets the model reuse the unchanged prompt state, but the serving front end often re-tokenizes the entire transcript for every call. Coding agents make this expensive: most calls append a small tool result to a long session history. Reusing previous token IDs is not trivial because tokenization is not compositional; a short append can change token boundaries near the end of the previous text.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly in serving systems rather than pretraining, but it is relevant to base-model researchers who care about long-context and agent workloads. The paper shows that when prompt-cache hit rate approaches 0.99, tokenization can grow from 10% to 64% of time-to-first-token in component measurements. It also gives a useful reminder: tokenizer behavior is part of the model interface. Approximate token reuse, fixed-overlap heuristics, or non-equivalent GPU tokenizers can change input IDs and silently invalidate prefix-cache keys.
summary_en.technical_approach: TokTier uses two execution paths under an exactness contract: every emitted token sequence must match a frozen reference tokenizer on the full request text. For session continuations, it stores token IDs and byte spans for each live session. On append, it re-tokenizes the new text plus a suffix of the old context, compares fresh and cached token records, and splices only after a stable-boundary check proves that the pre-tokenizer cannot observe across the boundary. If the check fails, TokTier widens the repair window and eventually falls back to full reference tokenization. For calls without a reusable prefix, it implements an exact GPU path for GPT-family tokenizers. The sequential regex stage is replaced by a run decomposition over maximal character-class runs; piece starts are derived from run position, bounded neighboring text, and run-level summaries. A GPU BPE pipeline then encodes the pieces. Short inputs remain on CPU, tokenizer artifacts are content-addressed, and a background verifier samples live requests and compares against the reference implementation.
summary_en.experiments: The workload analysis covers 153,951 calls from two agent ecosystems. The median call appends about 1.4K characters, while only 1.0–3.6% of calls start or rebuild a session. The fleet-level prompt-cache hit rate is 94.1%, and typical contexts are reported around 86K to 123K tokens, with some full contexts reaching millions of characters. For correctness, the evaluation covers 17 tokenizer families with pinned artifacts, synthetic and adversarial inputs, a full sweep over a 12.4TB real-text corpus, and more than 93,000 replayed agent steps, with no reported divergence from the reference. For performance, incremental repair stays at 0.5–1.1ms from 100K to 3M characters. It is 2.1× faster than the strongest cache-based alternative at 1M characters and 3.0× faster at 2M. The GPU full-context path sustains 3.8–4.7GB/s and tokenizes a 1M-character context in 0.87ms, 23.4× below the fastest previously published CPU method in their comparison. Integrated with vLLM, TokTier reduces median TTFT by 16–34% under loaded regimes and P99 by 23% under recorded burst arrivals.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 20–30 minutes. Start with the workload measurements and the TTFT component sweep; they justify why tokenization matters once KV-cache reuse is high. Then read the non-compositional tokenization examples and the stable-boundary check, which are the core correctness mechanisms. The GPU tokenizer section is useful if you care about tokenizer design or serving-time tokenizer cost, especially the exact reformulation of GPT-style regex pre-tokenization. In the evaluation, focus on the differential-testing setup, the repair-latency curves, and the vLLM end-to-end TTFT results.

recommendation.zh: 不是预训练论文，但它把一个常被忽略的 serving 真瓶颈讲清楚了；只看 exactness contract 和 stable-boundary 机制，足够启发 tokenizer/serving 接口设计。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it cleanly exposes a real serving bottleneck people usually hand-wave away; read the exactness contract and stable-boundary mechanism, then move on.

paper.title: DeltaServe: Host-Agnostic Co-Serving of Inference and Fine-Tuning for LLMs
paper.abstract: LLM serving systems are provisioned for peak load to meet strict latency targets, leaving substantial GPU compute idle whenever traffic falls below peak. We present DeltaServe, a host-agnostic co-serving design that converts this idle inference capacity into LoRA fine-tuning throughput while preserving inference service-level objectives (SLOs). DeltaServe integrates with existing inference engines through a compact hook interface that requires only multi-LoRA batching support. It exploits the sh

summary.core_problem: 生产环境LLM推理集群通常按峰值负载预留GPU，导致大量空闲算力；如何在不破坏推理延迟SLO的前提下，把这些零散空闲算力安全地用于LoRA微调，并且能以低侵入方式接入现有推理引擎？
summary.importance: 对大模型基础设施和持续模型更新流程有实际价值。论文解决的是serving系统层面的问题，不属于基座预训练核心研究，但对“pretrain/持续微调与在线服务共用资源”这一工程现实有参考意义：当持续预训练、adapter增量更新、在线评测变成日常流程时，集群级别的资源复用会直接影响训练迭代速度和成本。
summary.technical_approach: DeltaServe不是重写一个新的serving系统，而是一个host-agnostic的协同调度层，通过轻量hook接入已有推理引擎，只要求引擎支持multi-LoRA batching。核心观察是LoRA微调的前向计算和推理prefill在结构上几乎一致，因此可以把微调前向折叠进推理batch，而不是作为独立任务竞争资源。系统包含三部分：(1) 一个CUDA-graph感知的延迟模型，离线校准、在线修正，按batch粒度预测加入微调任务后对TTFT/TPOT的影响；(2) SLO感知的准入调度器，根据当前推理负载动态准入、节流、暂停、恢复微调任务；(3) 解耦的backward执行器，把长耗时的反向传播从推理关键路径上拆开，避免阻塞token级延迟。已接入vLLM、SGLang、S-LoRA三个引擎。
summary.experiments: 基于生产trace的评估显示，平均推理负载约为峰值的60%，存在显著可回收算力。与此前LLMStation、FlexLLM等co-serving方案相比，DeltaServe在严格满足推理SLO的前提下获得更高的LoRA微调吞吐，且避免了LLMStation受TPOT预算限制、FlexLLM分块带来的数据搬运开销问题。具体数字以系统评测中的吞吐提升和SLO违约率为主，论文重点强调在不增加TTFT/TPOT违约的情况下吃掉空闲算力。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，适合关心训练-服务一体化资源调度的读者。重点看Introduction里对现有co-location方案局限的梳理、Figure/Section中关于prefill与LoRA前向共享结构的解释、SLO感知调度器与backward解耦设计，以及三个引擎集成的工程接口设计。预计阅读时间20–30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Production LLM inference clusters are provisioned for peak traffic and leave substantial GPU idle capacity at off-peak times. How can this fragmented spare capacity be safely used for LoRA fine-tuning without violating inference latency SLOs, while remaining easy to integrate into existing inference engines?
summary_en.importance: The paper is primarily a serving-systems contribution rather than a core pretraining method, but it is practically relevant to the infrastructure around continual model updates. As continual pretraining, adapter refresh, and online evaluation become routine, cluster-level resource reuse between serving and fine-tuning directly affects iteration speed and cost.
summary_en.technical_approach: DeltaServe is not a new standalone serving stack but a host-agnostic co-serving layer added to existing inference engines through a compact hook interface; the only required host capability is multi-LoRA batching, already supported by modern engines. The key observation is that the LoRA fine-tuning forward pass is structurally identical to inference prefill, so fine-tuning forward work can be folded into inference batches instead of competing as a separate workload. The design has three main pieces: (1) a CUDA-graph-aware latency model, calibrated offline and refined online, that predicts at batch granularity how admitting fine-tuning will affect TTFT and TPOT; (2) an SLO-aware admission scheduler that admits, throttles, pauses, and resumes fine-tuning as inference load fluctuates; and (3) a decoupled backward executor that moves the long backward pass off the inference critical path to avoid blocking token-level latency. The system is integrated into vLLM, SGLang, and S-LoRA using the same host-agnostic core.
summary_en.experiments: Traces from a production coding co-pilot service show average inference load around 60% of provisioned capacity, leaving substantial recoverable compute. Compared with prior co-serving systems such as LLMStation and FlexLLM, DeltaServe achieves higher LoRA fine-tuning throughput while staying within strict inference SLOs, avoiding LLMStation’s tight TPOT constraints and FlexLLM’s per-chunk data-movement overhead. The reported results focus on fine-tuning throughput gains under zero or negligible SLO violations.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim, especially for readers interested in training-serving unification and cluster scheduling. Focus on the introduction’s taxonomy of prior co-location approaches, the structural equivalence between prefill and LoRA forward passes, the SLO-aware scheduler and decoupled backward design, and the integration interface across vLLM, SGLang, and S-LoRA. Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读调度和 latency model 部分即可；它不改预训练方法，但会影响训练平台如何榨干 serving 空档。
recommendation.en: Read the scheduler and latency-model sections; it does not change pretraining, but it affects how training platforms exploit serving slack.

paper.title: Kernel Forge: An Agent Harness for LLM-based Generation and Optimization of CUDA Kernels

Agentic systems built on large language models (LLMs) can now generate and optimize kernels with far less human effort, yet exi

summary.core_problem: 让 LLM agent 自动为未修改的 PyTorch 模型生成和优化 CUDA kernel，减少低层 GPU 优化对专家工程师的依赖。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理与训练系统侧的工程工具。它把 agentic kernel generation 从孤立 toy kernel 推向完整 PyTorch 模型，并覆盖 vision、diffusion、LLM 等 workload，对 serving 和训练成本优化有间接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Kernel Forge，一个开源端到端 agent harness。系统接收原始 PyTorch 模型，使用 MCTS 探索多个优化候选，生成 CUDA kernel，并提供检查、调试和重新集成支持，避免只输出难以落地的 standalone 代码。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、GPU 类型、加速比例或 baseline 数字。实验声称覆盖 vision、diffusion 和 LLM workload，重点应是实际模型级 kernel 替换，而不是随机 tensor 上的孤立 kernel microbenchmark。
summary.authors_note: Jason Mars 和 Lingjia Tang 是机器学习系统与硬件/软件协同优化方向的知名研究者；给定元数据未提供机构信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to use LLM agents to generate and optimize CUDA kernels directly for unmodified PyTorch models, reducing reliance on expert GPU programmers.
summary_en.importance: This is an engineering-system contribution for efficiency. It moves LLM-based kernel generation closer to real model integration, covering vision, diffusion, and LLM workloads instead of isolated synthetic kernels.
summary_en.technical_approach: Kernel Forge is an open-source end-to-end agent harness. It takes a PyTorch model in place, uses Monte Carlo Tree Search to explore optimization candidates, emits CUDA kernels, and supports inspection, debugging, and reintegration.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide speedup numbers, GPU details, model sizes, or baseline results. It emphasizes model-level workloads across vision, diffusion, and LLMs rather than random-tensor kernel tests.
summary_en.authors_note: Jason Mars and Lingjia Tang are known researchers in ML systems and hardware/software co-design; affiliations are not provided in the supplied metadata.

recommendation.zh: 看系统接口和失败分析即可；MCTS 写 CUDA 有工程味，但缺少速度数字前别调整路线。
recommendation.en: Read the system interface and failure analysis only; MCTS for CUDA is plausible, but do not update plans without speedup data.

paper.title: Kalypso: Relational LLM Serving
paper.abstract: Large language models are increasingly used as semantic operators for filtering, extracting, ranking, joining, and transforming unstructured data. Existing semantic query processing systems invoke request-centric LLM serving systems that are unaware of the query plan, leaving substantial performance opportunities unused. This paper introduces relational LLM serving, an abstraction that makes LLM serving aware of semantic query structure while preserving query semantics and output accuracy. The k

summary.core_problem: 现有请求中心化的LLM服务系统无法感知语义查询的算子计划结构，导致多算子流水线场景下KV缓存复用率低、推理成本高。
summary.importance: 跨算子KV缓存复用的思路，为预训练阶段优化缓存友好的注意力架构、针对结构化查询类工作负载设计训练数据提供了下游约束参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出关系型LLM服务抽象，在语义查询处理系统与底层推理引擎之间新增一层感知完整查询计划的服务层。核心是利用语义算子流水线执行时中间元组直接传递的KV前缀复用机会，设计自适应内存感知调度器：为每个算子预留前缀缓存的内存预算，根据内存利用率动态调整并发算子数量，在避免前缀提前淘汰的同时保证GPU利用率。还定义了支持语义算子与查询计划的通用API，兼容现有语义查询系统的代理模型、向量索引等优化。与现有减少请求数或使用近似模型的优化不同，该方法从服务层本身优化，不改变查询语义与输出精度。
summary.experiments: 给定的全文内容未覆盖完整实验章节，暂无法提供具体性能指标。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读系统设计与调度算法章节，以及实验部分（如有）。重点理解跨算子KV缓存复用的调度约束，预计阅读时间20-30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing request-centric LLM serving systems lack visibility into semantic query operator plan structure, leading to low KV cache reuse rates and high inference costs in multi-operator pipeline scenarios.
summary_en.importance: The cross-operator KV cache reuse idea provides downstream constraint references for pre-training research, including optimizing cache-friendly attention architectures and designing training data for structured query workloads.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces the relational LLM serving abstraction, a new layer between semantic query processing systems and underlying inference engines that has full visibility into the complete query plan. The core insight is that pipelined execution of semantic operators enables KV prefix reuse when intermediate tuples are passed directly between operators. An adaptive memory-aware scheduler reserves memory budgets for each operator's prefix cache, and dynamically adjusts concurrent operator count to avoid premature prefix eviction while maintaining GPU utilization. It also defines a general API for semantic operators and query plans, compatible with existing SQPS optimizations such as proxy models and vector indexes. Unlike prior optimizations that reduce request count or use approximate models, this approach optimizes serving itself without altering query semantics or output accuracy.
summary_en.experiments: The provided full text does not cover the complete experimental section, so specific performance metrics are not available from the given content.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the system design and scheduling algorithm sections, plus the experimental section if available. Focus on understanding the scheduling constraints of cross-operator KV cache reuse. Estimated reading time: 20-30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 做 LLM serving / 批量数据处理系统的人看调度问题建模即可；KV-cache 跨调用复用的思路对长文档批量抽取有参考，预训练侧无关。
recommendation.en: Relevant if you build LLM serving or batch data-processing stacks — the cross-operator KV reuse idea matters for bulk extraction; irrelevant to pretrain.

paper.title: Mage-Flow: An Efficient Native-Resolution Foundation Model for Image Generation and Editing

summary.core_problem: 大规模视觉生成模型训练/微调/部署成本高，需要紧凑高效且支持原生分辨率的生成栈。
summary.importance: 工程系统创新：4B 规模紧凑生成栈，在 tokenizer 和训练吞吐上做了实打实的系统优化（~2.5× 训练吞吐），并覆盖生成+编辑+RL 对齐+Turbo 全变体。
summary.technical_approach: Mage-VAE：一步扩散式编解码 + anchor-latent 正则，重建质量对标公开强 VAE 但 tokenization 成本降一个数量级；Native-Resolution Multimodal DiT 用 rectified flow matching，配合 native-resolution packing 和 CUDA kernel fusion 支持灵活分辨率训练。

summary_en.core_problem: Large-scale visual generators are costly to train, fine-tune, and deploy; a compact, efficient, native-resolution generative stack is needed.
summary_en.importance: Engineering/systems contribution: a compact 4B generative stack with concrete systems optimizations (~2.5× training throughput) and a full family covering generation, editing, RL alignment, and Turbo variants.
summary_en.technical_approach: Mage-VAE: one-step diffusion-style encoding/decoding with anchor-latent regularization, matching strong public VAEs in reconstruction while cutting tokenization cost by >10×; Native-Resolution Multimodal DiT trained with rectified flow matching, plus native-resolution packing and CUDA kernel fusion for flexible-resolution training.
summary_en.experiments: 4B-scale; tokenization cost reduced >10×; ~2.5× end-to-end training throughput; Base/RL-aligned/Turbo variants for generation and editing; no concrete FID/benchmark numbers in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 工程细节（anchor-latent VAE、native-resolution packing、kernel fusion）对做统一多模态 tokenizer+DiT 的人有参考，纯文本预训练可略过。
recommendation.en: Engineering details (anchor-latent VAE, native-resolution packing, kernel fusion) are useful if you build unified multimodal tokenizer+DiT stacks; text-only pretrain folks can skip.

paper.title: JoyNexus: Service-Oriented Multi-Tenant Post-Training for VLA Models
paper.abstract: The post-training of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models is essential due to the diversity of simulators, robot embodiments, and task objectives. Existing compute services, whether offered as direct accelerator rental or batch-workload submission, typically allocate an exclusive set of GPU and CPU resources to a single tenant. While this paradigm maximizes client flexibility, it burdens users with infrastructure adaptation, and the fixed card-hour accounting model renders short or bursty workloa

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLA 模型后训练中多租户、短任务、突发任务在算力服务上成本高、资源利用率低、环境适配重的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型偏系统工程：把 VLA 的 SFT、RL rollout 和评测做成统一服务，关注多租户共享、常驻模型和环境服务解耦；对通用 LLM 预训练方法论的直接增益有限，但对大规模后训练平台设计有参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 JoyNexus，将 Training Model Service、Inference Model Service 和 Environment Service 解耦，通过 API 暴露训练、rollout、评测等高层语义接口；底层使用常驻共享 base model，并为不同租户保留 tenant-specific slots，避免每个任务独占完整 GPU/CPU 资源。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整模型规模、租户数量、吞吐、排队延迟或成本节省数字；能确认的是系统覆盖 VLA supervised fine-tuning、reinforcement learning 和 evaluation 三类工作负载。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses inefficient and expensive infrastructure for multi-tenant, bursty post-training workloads of Vision-Language-Action models.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a systems contribution: it packages VLA SFT, RL rollout, and evaluation into a shared service. It is only indirectly relevant to LLM pretraining, but it may inform post-training platform design.
summary_en.technical_approach: JoyNexus decouples the Training Model Service, Inference Model Service, and Environment Service behind high-level APIs. It uses resident shared base models plus tenant-specific slots, instead of allocating exclusive accelerator and CPU resources to each tenant.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report concrete model sizes, tenant counts, throughput, latency, or cost-reduction numbers. It states support for VLA supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and evaluation workloads.

recommendation.zh: 偏后训练平台工程，扫架构图即可；若没有利用率和隔离数据，不足以改变训练服务设计。
recommendation.en: Mostly post-training platform engineering; skim the architecture, and ignore strong claims unless utilization and isolation numbers are shown.

paper.title: MetaInfer: A Knowledge Only LLM Inference Engine Generator SKILL Toolbox
paper.abstract: As LLM technology advances, the space of model families, compute hardware, quantization schemes, parallelization strategies, and specialized optimization kernels continues to expand, sharply increasing the code complexity and maintenance cost of general-purpose inference frameworks. Conventional software engineering uses multiple layers of abstraction to support diverse application scenarios, but these abstractions also increase system complexity and may introduce additional performance overhead

summary.core_problem: 解决通用 LLM 推理框架在模型族、硬件、量化、并行和 kernel 组合快速膨胀后，代码复杂度和维护成本过高的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型偏系统创新：不是提出新的推理 kernel 或 serving 算法，而是尝试用 LLM 多智能体把“推理框架生成”自动化，降低为特定约束定制 inference engine 的工程成本。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MetaInfer，将用户输入抽象为运行时约束；系统由 LLM 驱动的多智能体协作流程和 contract knowledge base 组成，根据约束自动生成紧凑的定制化推理框架。方法更像 LLM-as-Compiler / LLM-for-systems engineering，而不是手写统一框架后再靠多层抽象适配不同场景。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示实验从 source-code reference 的作用、zero-reference 设置下生成引擎的运行行为和性能 profile 等角度评估；未给出模型参数量、硬件配置、吞吐/延迟提升幅度或与 vLLM/TensorRT-LLM 等成熟系统的直接数字对比。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the rising code complexity and maintenance burden of general-purpose LLM inference frameworks as model families, hardware, quantization formats, parallelism strategies, and custom kernels diversify.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a systems workflow rather than a new inference kernel: it uses LLM agents to automate the generation of customized inference engines under explicit runtime constraints.
summary_en.technical_approach: MetaInfer frames the task as an LLM-as-Compiler problem. Users specify runtime constraints, and an LLM-driven multi-agent system, backed by a contract knowledge base, generates a compact inference framework tailored to those constraints.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract mentions evaluations on the effect of source-code references and the runtime behavior and performance profile of generated engines under zero-reference settings. It does not expose concrete model sizes, hardware setups, latency/throughput numbers, or direct comparisons with production inference stacks.

recommendation.zh: 只适合维护 serving 栈的人扫实验；对预训练方法没有直接信号，关键风险是 LLM 生成代码的可靠性和可复现实验。
recommendation.en: Skim only if you own a serving stack; it gives little pretraining signal, and the main risk is whether LLM-generated systems code is reliable and reproducible.

paper.title: Towards Efficient Large Language Model Serving: A Survey on System-Aware KV Cache Optimization

The key-value (KV) cache, which stores KV tensors during autoregressive decoding, is crucial for enabling low-latency, high-throughput LLM inference serving. In this survey, we focus on system-aware KV infrastructure for serving LLMs (abbreviated as sKis). We revisit recent work from a system behavior perspective, organizing existing efforts into three dimensions: execution and

summary.core_problem: 系统梳理 LLM serving 中 KV cache 的优化空间，回答内存成本和吞吐瓶颈该如何从系统视角拆解。
summary.importance: 这是综述而非新方法，但主题很实用：KV cache 已经是大模型部署的主瓶颈之一。对做长上下文、推理成本、甚至训练-推理接口设计的人都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 文章把现有 KV cache 工作按三条轴组织：时间维的执行与调度、空间维的放置与迁移、结构维的表示与保留；同时讨论不同系统行为之间的协同设计关系，以及这些设计与延迟、吞吐、内存占用等目标的映射。
summary.experiments: 作为 survey，没有统一实验。价值主要在分类框架和问题分解，而不是新的 benchmark 数字或方法增益。
summary.authors_note: The University of Melbourne、华中科技大学。作者未见到明确的一线 LLM serving 代表性团队信号。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper systematizes the optimization space of KV cache in LLM serving, focusing on how to decompose memory and throughput bottlenecks from a systems perspective.
summary_en.importance: This is a survey rather than a new method, but the topic is practical: KV cache is now one of the dominant bottlenecks in LLM deployment. It is useful for researchers thinking about long context, inference cost, and train–serve interface design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The survey organizes prior work along three axes: execution and scheduling in time, placement and migration in space, and representation and retention in structure. It also discusses co-design affinities across behaviors and their links to latency, throughput, and memory objectives.

summary_en.authors_note: The University of Melbourne and Huazhong University of Science and Technology. No clearly identifiable flagship LLM serving lab signal from the metadata alone.

recommendation.zh: 不是新结果，但分类框架还算干净；做长上下文或 serving 的人看 taxonomy 即可，别指望有新结论。
