paper.title: VisMMOE: Exploiting Visual-Expert Affinity for Efficient Visual-Language MoE Offloading
paper.abstract: Large-scale vision-language mixture-of-experts (VL-MoE) models provide strong multimodal capability, but efficient deployment on memory-constrained platforms remains difficult. Existing MoE offloading systems are largely designed for text-centric workloads and become much less effective for visual-heavy inputs, where large numbers of visual tokens induce broader and less predictable expert accesses. We present VisMMoE, a VL-MoE offloading system built on a single systems insight: pruning redunda

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是视觉语言 MoE 在单 GPU 或显存受限环境下的 expert offloading 延迟问题，重点是视觉 token 会激活更分散、更难预测的专家集合。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献有限，更偏推理系统。但它有一个值得保留的观察：视觉 token 压缩不只减少 FLOPs，也会改变 MoE router 的专家访问分布。这个现象对多模态 MoE 的架构设计、视觉 tokenizer、router 训练和 serving-aware pretraining 都有启发。多模态模型里的 token 冗余会通过路由放大成参数访问冗余，这一点比普通 token pruning 更接近基座模型系统协同问题。
summary.technical_approach:
VisMMOE 的核心概念是 visual-expert affinity。作者观察到，原始视觉 token 往往让 MoE 层访问较大的 expert working set，导致 cache reuse 下降、PCIe 传输增加、prefetch 失准。剪掉冗余视觉 token 后，专家访问会更集中，跨层也更稳定。

系统由几部分组成。Affinity-Aware Token Compressor 不只按语义重要性保留视觉 token，还考虑保留下来的 token 是否会造成分散的 expert demand。Compression-Guided Lookahead Predictor 利用压缩后的 token 和早期路由信息预测后续层需要的专家集合，从而扩大预取窗口。Expert Caching and Pipeline Orchestrator 负责在 GPU 显存、主机内存和 PCIe 带宽约束下协调计算、专家传输、缓存替换和 pipeline overlap。

和文本 MoE offloading 系统相比，它的区别在于把视觉 token 压缩纳入 offloading 策略，而不是只做 expert cache 或 router 预测。和常规视觉 token pruning 相比，它优化的目标也不只是精度和计算量，还包括专家工作集的紧凑性和可预测性。
summary.experiments:
论文在 commodity GPU 平台上评测了代表性的 VL-MoE 模型，并与实际可用的 offloading baseline 对比。给定内容说明 VisMMOE 能降低端到端推理延迟，同时保持接近原模型的任务精度。实验应覆盖不同显存预算、不同视觉 token 数量、不同 expert pool 大小，以及 cache/prefetch 策略。

给定材料没有提供具体延迟降低比例、准确率变化和硬件配置数值，因此这些数字需要直接查实验表。泛读时更应关注趋势：视觉 token 越多、expert pool 越大、显存越紧，visual-expert affinity 带来的系统收益应越明显。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20 到 30 分钟。先看动机部分和 Figure 1，确认视觉 token 是否真的造成更分散的 expert activation，以及 pruning 后访问模式是否变集中。然后看系统设计中 token compressor 和 lookahead predictor 的接口，理解它如何把 token 选择和 expert 预取绑定起来。实验部分重点看端到端 latency、cache hit rate、prefetch accuracy、accuracy drop 四类指标。对基座预训练研究员来说，不必细读 pipeline 工程细节，但值得记下 router 分布会被视觉 token 冗余显著扰动这一点。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies efficient offloading for vision-language MoE models under tight GPU memory budgets. The key issue is that visual-heavy inputs activate a broader and less predictable set of experts than text-only inputs, which makes expert caching and prefetching less effective.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an inference-systems paper, not a pretraining-method paper. Its useful signal for foundation-model research is the link between visual token redundancy and MoE routing behavior. Visual token pruning does not only reduce compute; it can also make expert demand more compact and predictable. This matters for multimodal MoE design, router training, visual tokenization, and serving-aware model construction.
summary_en.technical_approach:
VisMMOE is built around the idea of visual-expert affinity. The authors profile VL-MoE workloads and observe that raw visual tokens scatter expert accesses across layers. After pruning redundant visual tokens, the expert working set becomes smaller and more stable.

The system combines three components. The Affinity-Aware Token Compressor selects visual tokens while considering both task fidelity and expert-locality effects. The Compression-Guided Lookahead Predictor uses the compressed token stream and early routing signals to predict future expert demand, giving the runtime a larger prefetch window. The Expert Caching and Pipeline Orchestrator coordinates GPU memory, host-to-device transfers, computation, cache replacement, and overlap.

The difference from standard MoE offloading is that token compression becomes part of the offloading policy. The difference from ordinary visual token pruning is that the objective includes expert working-set compactness, not only semantic salience or FLOP reduction.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper evaluates VisMMOE on representative VL-MoE models and commodity GPU platforms. The provided content states that it reduces end-to-end inference latency compared with practical baselines while maintaining competitive accuracy. The relevant experiments should include latency under different memory budgets, cache reuse, prefetch accuracy, visual token counts, and expert-pool sizes.

Exact latency reductions, accuracy deltas, and hardware configurations are not included in the supplied material. The main trend to verify in the tables is whether the benefit grows with more visual tokens, larger expert pools, and tighter memory constraints.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20 to 30 minutes. Start with the profiling figures, especially the comparison between text tokens, raw visual tokens, and pruned visual tokens in terms of expert activation patterns. Then read the design of the token compressor and lookahead predictor to see how token selection is tied to expert prefetching. In the evaluation, focus on end-to-end latency, cache hit rate, prefetch precision or recall, and accuracy loss. The pipeline details are less central unless the goal is to implement a similar offloading runtime.

recommendation.zh: 系统味很重但 insight 真实：token pruning 会改变 MoE 路由分布与工作集；只看 affinity 定义和缓存命中/working-set 曲线。
recommendation.en: Systems-heavy but the insight is real: token pruning changes MoE routing and the expert working set; skim the affinity definition and the cache-hit/working-set plots.

paper.title: VibeServe: Can AI Agents Build Bespoke LLM Serving Systems?
paper.abstract: For years, we have built LLM serving systems like any other critical infrastructure: a single general-purpose stack, hand-tuned over many engineer-years, meant to support every model and workload. In this paper, we take the opposite bet: a multi-agent loop that automatically synthesizes bespoke serving systems for different usage scenarios. We propose VibeServe, the first agentic loop that generates entire LLM serving stacks end-to-end. VibeServe uses an outer loop to plan and track the search o

summary.core_problem: 能否用多智能体自动搜索并生成面向特定场景定制的 LLM serving 系统，而不是依赖单一通用 serving 栈。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是系统与 Agent-for-systems：把代码生成、正确性检查和性能评测闭环起来，自动合成 serving stack。对基座研究不是直接方法论，但对推理系统 co-design 有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 VibeServe：外层 agent 负责规划和跟踪系统设计搜索，内层 agent 负责实现候选系统、验证正确性并在目标 benchmark 上测性能。核心不是单点优化，而是自动化探索 serving 设计空间。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在标准部署场景下与 vLLM 竞争，在六类非标准场景中优于现有系统，说明定制化系统在特殊 workload 下能挖到通用栈遗漏的机会；但从摘要看，结果更偏工程 case study，泛化边界仍需看正文。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Washington。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether multi-agent loops can automatically synthesize bespoke LLM serving systems instead of relying on one general-purpose serving stack.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a systems and agent-for-systems contribution: it closes the loop among code generation, correctness checking, and performance evaluation to synthesize serving stacks. It is not directly about pretraining, but it may inform inference-system co-design.
summary_en.technical_approach: VibeServe uses an outer loop to plan and track the search over system designs, and an inner loop to implement candidates, verify correctness, and benchmark them on target workloads. The key idea is automated exploration of the serving design space rather than a single optimization trick.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims competitiveness with vLLM in standard deployment and wins in six non-standard scenarios, suggesting specialization can exploit opportunities missed by generic stacks. Still, the evidence appears more like engineering case studies, and the generalization boundary needs the full paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of Washington.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但若你关心训练后部署反哺架构设计，只看系统搜索空间和六个非标准场景即可。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but if deployment constraints feed back into architecture choices, read the search-space design and the six non-standard scenarios.

paper.title: Coral: Cost-Efficient Multi-LLM Serving over Heterogeneous Cloud GPUs
paper.abstract: The usage of large language models (LLMs) has grown increasingly fragmented, with no single model dominating. Meanwhile, cloud providers offer a wide range of mid-tier and older-generation GPUs that enjoy better availability and deliver comparable performance per dollar to top-tier hardware. To efficiently harness these heterogeneous resources for serving multiple LLMs concurrently, we introduce Coral, an adaptive heterogeneity-aware multi-LLM serving system. The key idea behind Coral is to join

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决多模型 LLM 在线服务中的联合优化问题：在云上 GPU 类型、价格、地域可用性不断变化的情况下，同时决定购买哪些异构节点，以及每个模型副本如何切分和放置，目标是在满足吞吐和延迟 SLO 的前提下降低成本。
summary.importance: 这不是预训练方法论文，但对基座模型研究有工程参考价值。模型族和模型尺寸越来越分散，训练团队在评估模型发布形态时，不能只看单模型质量，也要考虑 serving 可部署性、异构硬件适配和多模型组合成本。Coral 的启发在于把模型 placement 从在线决策中拆出来，形成可缓存的 Serving Template。这类思路也会影响预训练阶段的架构取舍，例如模型大小、层宽、KV cache 占用、prefill/decode 比例，以及是否容易在非同构 GPU 上切分运行。
summary.technical_approach: Coral 将问题拆成离线和在线两阶段。离线阶段针对每个 model 和 latency SLO，枚举一组有代表性的节点组合，并用 ILP 求解该组合上的吞吐最优模型放置方案。求得的结果被缓存为 Serving Template。关键观察是：给定模型、SLO 和节点组合后，最优 placement 只依赖这个组合，不依赖其他模型如何占用集群。因此 placement 可以离线复用。在线阶段只需要用轻量 ILP 在不同 region、GPU 价格和可用性约束下选择模板，满足各模型的实时吞吐需求并最小化成本。系统实现使用 ZeroMQ 和 NCCL，单节点执行引擎基于 vLLM，同时构建了事件驱动模拟器来做大规模评估。
summary.experiments: 评估覆盖 6 个模型、5 类 GPU、20 种 GPU 配置，并考虑资源可用性和吞吐需求变化。论文报告 Coral 相比最强 baseline 最高降低 2.79 倍 serving cost；在资源稀缺场景下，最高获得 2.39 倍 goodput。在线求解时间从直接联合搜索可能需要的小时级降到几十秒级，使系统能够跟上价格、可用性和请求量变化。论文还强调，已有方法如果把每个模型副本当作 homogeneous black box，会漏掉大量异构 placement 的成本空间；反过来，如果只做单模型异构 placement，再在外层枚举资源分配，搜索开销不可接受。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25 到 35 分钟。优先看问题形式化、Serving Template 的定义、离线 ILP 与在线 ILP 的分解理由，以及资源稀缺场景的评估。对预训练研究员来说，不必深挖系统实现细节；更值得关注的是异构 serving 约束如何反过来影响模型架构和模型规格设计。若关心推理成本建模，可以看 vLLM/NCCL runtime 与 simulator 的校准部分。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses joint optimization for serving many LLMs on heterogeneous cloud GPUs. Given per-model demand, latency SLOs, real-time GPU prices, and regional availability, the system must decide which nodes to provision and how to place each model replica across those nodes at minimum cost.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-serving paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to foundation-model engineering. Model providers increasingly serve many model families and sizes at the same time, and cloud supply is heterogeneous. The result is that model quality alone is not enough; deployability across mixed GPUs also matters. Coral’s template-based decomposition is useful for thinking about how architecture choices affect serving cost: parameter count, layer shape, KV-cache footprint, prefill/decode balance, and the ease of tensor or pipeline partitioning across non-identical hardware.
summary_en.technical_approach: Coral decomposes the joint problem into an offline placement stage and an online allocation stage. Offline, for each model and latency SLO, it enumerates a selected set of node combinations and solves an ILP to find the throughput-optimal placement on each combination. The resulting artifact is a Serving Template. The key observation is that, once the model, SLO, and node combination are fixed, the best placement does not depend on how the rest of the cluster is allocated. Online, Coral solves a smaller ILP that selects templates across regions under current price and availability constraints to satisfy demand at minimum cost. The implementation uses ZeroMQ and NCCL, with vLLM as the per-node execution engine. The authors also build an event-based simulator for larger-scale evaluation.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers 6 models, 5 GPU types, and 20 GPU configurations under changing demand and resource availability. Coral reduces serving cost by up to 2.79× over the strongest baseline. Under scarce availability, it delivers up to 2.39× higher goodput. The online solve runs in tens of seconds, compared with the hours-level cost implied by direct joint search or by wrapping single-model placement solvers inside an outer allocation enumeration. The experiments support the main design claim: treating each model replica as a homogeneous black box leaves cost savings unused, while solving full placement online is too slow for changing cloud conditions.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25 to 35 minutes. Focus on the problem formulation, the Serving Template abstraction, the offline/online ILP decomposition, and the scarce-resource evaluation. For pretraining researchers, the system-runtime details are less important than the implications for model design under heterogeneous serving constraints. If inference cost modeling is a focus, read the vLLM/NCCL runtime and simulator calibration sections more carefully.

recommendation.zh: 读系统模型和实验设置即可；它不会改变预训练 recipe，但会影响你对模型尺寸和 serving 成本的取舍。
recommendation.en: Skim the system model and setup; it will not change a pretraining recipe, but it may change size-vs-serving-cost decisions.

paper.title: Accelerating RL Post-Training Rollouts via System-Integrated Speculative Decoding
paper.abstract: RL post-training of frontier language models is increasingly bottlenecked by autoregressive rollout generation, making rollout acceleration a central systems challenge. Many existing efficiency methods improve throughput by changing the rollout or optimization regime, for example, through off-policy execution, replay, or lower-precision generation. We study speculative decoding as a lossless acceleration primitive for RL rollouts that preserves the target model's output distribution. We implemen

summary.core_problem: RL 后训练的主要耗时正在从反向传播转向 rollout 生成。论文关心的是：能否把 speculative decoding 作为一种不改变采样分布的系统原语，接入真实 RL 训练循环，而不是只在静态推理服务里做加速。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献有限，但对 pretrain-posttrain 接口有实际意义。推理型 RL、agentic RL 和长链条工具调用都会把 decode 成本放大。相比异步执行、off-policy replay、低精度 rollout，speculative decoding 的优点是保持 verifier policy 的采样分布不变，因此不会额外改变 policy-gradient 的训练语义。它更像是 RL 系统吞吐优化里的一个安全组件，而不是新的 RL 算法。
summary.technical_approach: 论文把 speculative decoding 集成到 NeMo-RL，并使用 vLLM 作为 rollout backend。目标模型仍然是训练中的 policy，draft 可以来自 EAGLE-3 路径、外部小模型，也可以来自模型内置的 multi-token prediction head。关键实现点不在解码算法本身，而在 RL 场景的工程约束：policy 每步更新后需要同步权重到 rollout engine；draft 需要随 policy 漂移保持一致；logprob、KL penalty 和 GRPO loss 必须按 verifier policy 计算，不能按 draft 计算。论文还把同步 RL 和异步 pipeline 都纳入设计，并讨论在线 draft adaptation、draft length、stage-level telemetry 等部署问题。它用 Amdahl 式分解说明收益边界：只有当生成阶段占 step time 的比例足够高，且平均接受长度 alpha 足够大时，端到端速度才会明显改善。
summary.experiments: 实验聚焦 8B 级 reasoning workload 下的同步 RL，并分析 draft 初始化、draft length、在线适配和异步执行的交互。正文给出的核心实验结论是：收益主要受三个量控制，分别是 generation share、平均接受长度和 draft/verification 的额外开销。speculative decoding 只加速 decode，不加速 prefill、logprob recomputation 或 optimizer step，因此当 prefill 占比高、训练计算占比高、或者 draft 与当前 policy 不匹配时，端到端收益会被压低。可用的正文片段没有给出完整速度提升数字、GPU 配置表或各消融的具体数值，因此不宜把它解读为通用加速倍率结论。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看系统分解和约束条件，而不是 speculative decoding 的基本介绍。建议优先读 Introduction 中对 RL rollout bottleneck 的定位，再读 Speculative Decoding for RL Rollouts 里对 T_prepare、T_gen、T_logprob、T_train 的分解，以及 R_gen 和 alpha 的速度上界。若关心后训练系统，可重点看权重同步、draft coherence、异步 pipeline 下 policy lag 的讨论。若只关心预训练方法，可快速略过实现细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a practical bottleneck in RL post-training: rollout generation, rather than gradient computation, often dominates wall-clock time. It asks whether speculative decoding can be used as a system-level primitive for RL rollouts while preserving the exact sampling distribution of the target policy.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly relevant to the pretrain-posttrain interface and large-scale RL infrastructure. It does not propose a new pretraining objective or model architecture. Its value is that it studies a lossless acceleration path for online policy sampling. This matters because many alternatives, such as asynchronous execution, replay, or lower-precision rollouts, change the training dynamics or introduce distribution mismatch.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method integrates speculative decoding into NeMo-RL with a vLLM rollout backend. The verifier remains the current policy being optimized. The draft source can be an EAGLE-3-style draft path, a smaller external draft model, or built-in multi-token prediction heads. The central engineering issue is that RL policies are not static: weights must be synchronized into the rollout engine after learner updates, the draft must remain coherent with the moving policy, and all log-probabilities, KL terms, and policy losses must be computed under the verifier policy rather than the draft. The paper analyzes the step-level speedup with an Amdahl-style bound controlled by the generation fraction and the mean accepted length per speculative step.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation is described on 8B-scale reasoning workloads under synchronous RL, with additional analysis of draft initialization, draft length, online adaptation, and interaction with asynchronous execution. The main empirical message is operational: realized gains depend on how much of each RL step is decode-bound, how well the draft tracks the target policy, and how much overhead is introduced by drafting, prefill, batching, and weight synchronization. The provided text does not include the full speedup table, GPU configuration, or numeric ablation results, so the result should be read as a system design study rather than a universal acceleration claim.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20–30 minutes. The most useful parts are the RL step decomposition, the speedup bound using generation share and accepted length, and the discussion of weight synchronization and draft coherence. Readers working on RL infrastructure should inspect the synchronous and asynchronous integration details. Readers focused on pretraining can treat it as background on why post-training rollout cost is becoming a first-order systems constraint.

recommendation.zh: 不是方法论文，是把 speculative decoding 真接进 RL 环路；若你关心 RL 成本曲线，这类系统细节比又一个 DPO 变体更该看，先盯吞吐和分布一致性验证。
recommendation.en: This is not a new learning method but a real integration of speculative decoding into RL rollouts; if RL cost curves matter to you, inspect throughput and distribution-preservation evidence before anything else.

paper.title: DORA: A Scalable Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning System for Language Model Training
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a critical paradigm for LLM post-training, yet the rollout phase -- accounting for 50--80% of total step time -- is bottlenecked by skewed generation: long-tailed trajectories indispensable for model performance block the entire training pipeline. Asynchronous training offers a natural remedy by overlapping generation with training, but introduces a fundamental tension between efficiency and algorithmic correctness. We identify three constraints in asynchro

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要解决的是 LLM 强化学习训练中的 rollout 吞吐瓶颈。同步训练会被最长生成样本卡住，而数学、代码和长 CoT 任务的生成长度分布很偏，99 分位长度可比中位数高一个数量级以上。直接异步化又会引入 stale trajectory，破坏 PPO/GRPO 等算法依赖的策略一致性。
summary.importance: 这篇更偏 post-training system，但对预训练研究员仍有用。原因是大规模 RL 已经成为推理模型训练的重要阶段，rollout 效率会决定可扩展的数据规模、长 CoT 保留率和训练稳定性。DORA 的价值在于把系统吞吐问题写成受算法约束的调度问题：不能为了消除气泡而丢掉长轨迹，也不能让同一条轨迹跨多个 policy version 生成。这个约束视角对 RL pretrain、continual RL、以及大规模 agent 数据生成都有借鉴意义。
summary.technical_approach: DORA 提出 multi-version streaming training。系统同时在 rollout 实例上维护多个 policy version，按轨迹级别流式送入训练，而不是等待整个 batch 的最长样本结束。它显式满足三个约束：C1，同一条 trajectory 必须由同一个 policy version 生成，保留 PPO/GRPO 所需的 intra-trajectory policy consistency；C2，不丢弃长尾轨迹，避免长度偏置采样，尤其是避免丢掉长 CoT；C3，用滑动窗口限制 rollout policy 与训练 policy 之间的版本滞后。系统侧引入集中式 Load-Balancing Orchestrator，动态重分配不同 policy version 的资源，并在实例之间迁移请求。一个关键设计点是：只要 C1 被保留，同一 policy version 下的 KV cache 在数学上等价，因此迁移请求时可以避免重新 prefill。这和 partial rollout 方法不同，后者把长轨迹切到多个权重版本上，能消除气泡，但放松了 C1，并带来 re-prefill 开销；在 MoE 和长上下文下，这个开销会更明显。
summary.experiments: 论文给出的动机数字是：rollout 通常占 RL step 时间的 50%–80%；在数学和代码任务中，99 分位输出长度可超过中位数一个数量级。实验部分应围绕三类指标解读：端到端训练吞吐、rollout 设备利用率和收敛质量。真正需要关注的是 DORA 是否在不丢弃长轨迹、不跨版本生成单条轨迹的前提下减少同步等待；还要看 bounded staleness 的窗口大小如何影响 reward 曲线、KL、policy loss 稳定性和最终任务表现。若实验包含与 one-step off-policy、replication-based over-generation、partial rollout 的比较，重点应放在长尾样本保留率和 re-prefill 开销，而不是只看 token/s。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 30–40 分钟。先读 Section 3.1 的三个约束 C1–C3，这是整篇的判断框架。再看 Section 3.3 对已有异步方案的拆解，重点比较 one-step off-policy、replication-based 和 partial rollout 的取舍。方法部分重点看 multi-version streaming training、滑动 staleness window、orchestrator 调度和 zero-re-prefill migration。实验部分优先看吞吐-收敛的联合曲线；如果只有吞吐提升而没有 reward/KL 稳定性，结论要谨慎。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the rollout bottleneck in RL training for language models. Synchronous training is blocked by the longest generation in a batch, while math, coding, and long-CoT workloads have heavily skewed length distributions. Naive asynchronous execution improves utilization but creates stale trajectories and can violate policy-consistency assumptions used by PPO and GRPO.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training systems paper, but it is relevant to foundation-model training because large-scale RL now controls the amount and quality of reasoning data a model can learn from. DORA frames asynchronous RL as a constrained systems problem: improve rollout utilization without discarding long trajectories, without generating a single trajectory under multiple policy versions, and without allowing unbounded policy lag. That framing is useful for RL pretraining, continual RL, and large-scale agent-data generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: DORA introduces multi-version streaming training. Rollout workers host multiple policy versions concurrently and stream completed trajectories to training without a batch-level barrier. The design enforces three constraints: C1, each trajectory is generated entirely by one policy version; C2, trajectories are retained rather than dropped, including long-tail CoT samples; and C3, a sliding window bounds staleness between rollout and training policies. A centralized load-balancing orchestrator reallocates resources across policy versions and migrates requests to keep rollout workers utilized. Preserving C1 also enables an important systems optimization: KV-cache states are equivalent across workers hosting the same policy version, so migration can avoid re-prefill. This differs from partial-rollout methods, which split long trajectories across weight updates and reduce waiting time at the cost of relaxing intra-trajectory consistency and adding re-prefill overhead, especially under MoE or long-context settings.
summary_en.experiments: The motivation section reports that rollout often takes 50%–80% of an RL step, and that the 99th-percentile output length in math and coding workloads can exceed the median by more than an order of magnitude. The key experimental questions are end-to-end throughput, rollout utilization, and convergence quality under bounded staleness. The most important comparisons are against one-step off-policy pipelines, replication-based over-generation, and partial-rollout systems. The useful metrics are not only token throughput, but also long-tail trajectory retention, re-prefill overhead, reward curves, KL behavior, and policy-loss stability.
summary_en.reading_guide: A good skim takes about 30–40 minutes. Start with Section 3.1 for the three constraints C1–C3, since they define the algorithmic contract. Then read the comparison of asynchronous strategies to understand why over-generation and partial rollout make different tradeoffs. In the method section, focus on multi-version streaming, the staleness window, orchestration, and zero-re-prefill migration. In the experiments, prioritize plots that show throughput and convergence together; throughput alone is not enough to validate the training method.

recommendation.zh: 异步 RL 不是新点，但把“正确性约束”讲清并围绕长尾轨迹做编排是可落地的；只看三条约束定义+他们如何控 staleness。
recommendation.en: Async RL isn’t new, but the explicit correctness constraints plus long-tail-aware orchestration are actionable; read the constraint definitions and how they bound staleness.

paper.title: Stream-CQSA: Avoiding Out-of-Memory in Attention Computation via Flexible Workload Scheduling
paper.abstract: The scalability of long-context large language models is fundamentally limited by the quadratic memory cost of exact self-attention, which often leads to out-of-memory (OOM) failures on modern hardware. Existing methods improve memory efficiency to near-linear complexity, while assuming that the full query, key, and value tensors fit in device memory. In this work, we remove this assumption by introducing CQS Divide, an operation derived from cyclic quorum sets (CQS) theory that decomposes atten

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的不是“attention 算得不够快”，而是更前面的一个硬约束：当上下文极长时，连完整的 Q/K/V 张量都放不进显存，FlashAttention 这类方法也无从启动。现有很多长上下文方法默认 full QKV 至少能驻留在设备内存里，然后再优化 attention kernel 或近似计算；作者指出，在极端长序列下，这个前提本身就失效了。论文要解决的是：在不改模型结构、不引入近似误差的前提下，如何把 exact self-attention 拆成一组可以流式调度的小任务，使每个子任务都能在任意给定显存预算下完成。
summary.importance: 从分类上看，这更偏 efficient / systems，而不是 llm_pretrain 方法学本身。但它对基座研究仍有现实意义，因为长上下文训练和推理经常不是被 FLOPs 卡住，而是被峰值显存卡住。论文的价值在于把“exact attention 需要完整 QKV 常驻显存”这个隐含假设拿掉了。这样一来，长上下文实验的可达区间会扩大，尤其是在训练资源有限、需要在较小 GPU 上做原型验证时。对预训练研究员的启发主要有两点：第一，context scaling 的瓶颈不只在算法复杂度，也在 workload scheduling；第二，很多所谓 exact attention 优化其实只是在 full-QKV-resident 假设下成立，这篇工作处理的是更底层的内存可行性问题。
summary.technical_approach:
方法由两个部分组成：CQS Divide 和 Stream-CQSA。

CQS Divide 是一个组合式分解。作者把 attention 看成 token 两两交互构成的完全图，然后用 cyclic quorum sets 的构造，把完整序列划分成若干 subsequences，使得所有 token pair 的交互在这些 subsequences 内被“恰好覆盖一次”。关键不是随便切块，而是要保证重组后与 full attention 完全等价。论文先把序列分成 c 个 chunk，再构造 c 个由 l 个 chunk 组成的 subsequences，并要求每个 chunk pair 只在一个 subsequence 中出现。由覆盖条件可得 c=l(l-1)+1，因此可用的 c 取值是 1,3,7,13,21,...。作者重点展开了最小非平凡情形 l=3,c=7，用 cyclic 的 interest set，例如 (0,1,3)，生成 7 个子序列。这个构造对应于把完全图 Kc 分解成若干 Kl 子图，和 Steiner system 有直接关系。

在具体计算上，每个 subsequence 从全局 Q/K/V 中 gather 出对应子张量，独立计算局部 attention 的 softmax 分子 Num_i 和分母 Den_i。然后把这些局部结果 scatter 回全局 token 坐标，累加成全局 Num 与 Den，最后做一次逐 token 归一化 O = Num ⊘ Den。这样做的关键点在于 softmax 不是直接对局部输出求平均，而是把 numerator / denominator 分开累积，因此重组后与全序列 softmax 完全一致。反向传播也沿同样的分解进行：先从全局输出梯度构造各子问题的 dNum_i、dDen_i，再求 dQ_i、dK_i、dV_i，最后 merge 回全局坐标。

Stream-CQSA 则是在这个精确分解之上做调度。因为每个 subsequence attention 都是独立任务，系统可以根据显存预算决定一次加载多少 chunk、何时 materialize 哪部分 QKV、何时释放中间结果。作者强调它是 memory-adaptive scheduling framework：把原本逻辑上单体的 attention 变成可调度任务集合，用更多时间换更低峰值显存。递归应用 CQS Divide 后，子问题还能继续细分，因此理论上可以适配任意小的可用内存。

和 FlashAttention 一类方法相比，区别不在于 kernel 更快，而在于问题设定不同。FlashAttention 优化的是在 full QKV 已经在显存中的情况下，减少中间矩阵 materialization 和 IO；Stream-CQSA 处理的是 full QKV 根本放不下时怎么办。和 sparse / low-rank / kernel attention 相比，它不做近似，输出与 exact attention 一致，但代价是更多调度开销和重复 gather/scatter。
summary.experiments:
从正文可见，实验重点应当是三类指标：正确性、峰值显存、以及时间开销。

正确性方面，作者的方法是 exact decomposition，不是近似 attention，因此核心结果应是数值上与 full attention 对齐，前向输出和反向梯度都能重构一致。正文已经给出 forward/backward algorithm，并在图示里验证 c=7、interest set=(0,1,3) 时 attention matrix 的全覆盖。若实验部分报告了与标准 attention 的最大误差或训练 loss 对齐，这部分是判断实现是否扎实的关键。

显存方面，论文的主张是可以在 full QKV 无法同时驻留显存时继续做 exact attention，因此应会展示在不同 sequence length、不同 memory budget 下，Stream-CQSA 避免 OOM 的能力，以及相对 baseline 的 peak memory 降幅。摘要里明确说它能把 attention 划成适配任意设备内存的子问题，这意味着实验大概率包含“baseline OOM，而 Stream-CQSA 仍可运行”的区间。对长上下文研究最有价值的不是单点速度，而是可运行边界被推到多远。

时间方面，代价是明确存在的。由于子序列之间有结构性重叠，且需要多次 gather/scatter 与重组，运行时间通常会比 full-resident 的高效 kernel 更慢。论文也提到这种 overlap 会带来 redundancy，因此实验里应会比较不同分解深度、不同 c/l 选择下的 time-memory trade-off。若有递归分解层数的消融，值得重点看，因为它决定了“省多少显存要付出多少额外计算”。

从给出的正文片段看，论文没有直接服务于预训练指标提升，而是提供一个 enabling system。阅读时应特别留意：它是否支持训练和推理两种模式；反向传播的内存节省是否同样显著；以及在真实长上下文模型上，能否与现有 kernel 或 activation checkpointing 组合使用。
summary.reading_guide:
先看 Introduction，确认作者解决的是“QKV 都放不下”的问题，而不是常规 attention kernel 优化。这个定位决定了它和 FlashAttention、ring attention、各种 sparse attention 的关系。

然后重点读 CQS Divide 的构造。需要真正看懂 c=l(l-1)+1 这个覆盖条件是怎么来的，以及为什么 cyclic interest set 能保证每个 chunk pair 恰好覆盖一次。Figure 1、Figure 2 和关于 c=7 的例子最关键。如果这里没看懂，后面的 exactness 就很难判断。

第三步看 forward/backward algorithm。重点不是公式推导本身，而是确认 softmax numerator / denominator 分开累积这一点，因为这正是“局部算完再全局重组仍然精确”的核心。Appendix 里如果有 chain rule 的完整推导，适合在需要实现时再细读。

最后看实验里的三张表或图：peak memory vs sequence length、runtime vs memory budget、以及与 full attention 的数值一致性。若只想判断是否值得跟进，30 分钟足够；若要评估能否用于自家长上下文训练栈，建议花 1 小时以上把算法和调度细节读透。对基座研究员来说，最值得思考的是它能否和现有 IO-aware kernel、activation recomputation、sequence parallel 一起组合，而不是单独替换一切。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a more fundamental memory bottleneck than standard efficient-attention work. Many exact or approximate attention methods assume that the full Q, K, and V tensors already fit in device memory, and then optimize the attention computation itself. At extreme context lengths, that assumption fails before attention even starts: simply materializing QKV can trigger OOM. The paper asks how to compute exact self-attention when full-sequence QKV cannot reside on the GPU at once, without changing the model architecture and without introducing approximation error.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a systems/efficiency paper rather than a pretraining-method paper, but it is relevant to foundation-model research because long-context scaling is often constrained by peak memory rather than raw FLOPs. The main value is that it removes an implicit assumption shared by much of the efficient-attention literature: exact attention should remain possible even when full QKV residency is impossible. For researchers working on long-context pretraining or prototyping on limited hardware, that matters. The paper also sharpens an important distinction: many “exact attention” optimizations solve IO and intermediate-buffer issues under a full-QKV-resident regime, whereas this work targets memory feasibility at an earlier stage in the pipeline.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method consists of a combinatorial decomposition, CQS Divide, and a scheduling framework, Stream-CQSA.

CQS Divide starts from a graph view of attention: full self-attention corresponds to all pairwise token interactions, i.e., a complete graph over tokens. The goal is to partition the sequence into subsequences such that every token-pair interaction is covered exactly once across the set of subsequence attentions. The construction is based on cyclic quorum sets. The sequence is first split into c chunks. Then c subsequences are built, each containing l chunks, under the condition that every chunk pair appears in exactly one subsequence. This yields the coverage constraint c = l(l-1)+1, so valid chunk counts are 1, 3, 7, 13, 21, and so on. The paper focuses on the smallest nontrivial case, l=3 and c=7, using a cyclic interest set such as (0,1,3). In graph terms, this is a decomposition of K_c into K_l subgraphs, closely related to Steiner systems.

The exactness comes from how softmax is recomposed. For each subsequence, the method gathers the corresponding Q_i, K_i, and V_i from the global tensors and computes local softmax numerator and denominator terms, Num_i and Den_i. These are then scattered back into global token coordinates and accumulated into global Num and Den, followed by a final token-wise normalization O = Num ⊘ Den. This is the key idea: the method does not average local attention outputs directly, which would be wrong under softmax. Instead, it accumulates numerator and denominator separately, preserving exact equivalence to full attention. The backward pass mirrors the same decomposition, constructing local gradient terms from the global upstream gradient and then merging dQ_i, dK_i, and dV_i back into full-sequence coordinates.

Stream-CQSA builds a memory-adaptive execution framework on top of this decomposition. Since each subsequence attention is independent, the system can schedule them according to an arbitrary memory budget: load only the necessary chunks, compute a subset, accumulate partial results, and release memory before moving on. Because CQS Divide is recursively applicable, the workload can be subdivided further when memory is tighter. The result is a time-for-memory trade-off that enables exact attention under memory budgets where full QKV materialization would otherwise be impossible.

Compared with FlashAttention-style methods, the difference is not a faster kernel but a different problem setting. FlashAttention assumes full QKV is available and optimizes IO and intermediate storage. Stream-CQSA addresses the case where that assumption already breaks. Compared with sparse, low-rank, or kernelized attention, it keeps exactness but pays in scheduling overhead and repeated gather/scatter operations.
summary_en.experiments:
From the paper structure, the experiments are likely organized around three questions: exactness, peak memory, and runtime trade-offs.

For correctness, the central claim is exact decomposition rather than approximation. So the most important evidence is numerical equivalence to standard full attention in both forward outputs and backward gradients. The paper already provides explicit forward and backward algorithms and visual verification of full coverage for the c=7, interest-set=(0,1,3) case. If the experimental section reports output error or gradient agreement against standard attention, that is the first thing to check.

For memory, the key claim is that exact attention remains executable even when full QKV cannot fit in memory. The most informative results should therefore show peak-memory reduction under different sequence lengths and memory budgets, especially regimes where baseline methods OOM while Stream-CQSA still runs. For long-context work, the most meaningful metric is often not speed at a fixed length, but how far the feasible context boundary moves under a given hardware budget.

For runtime, the cost is real and expected. The subsequences overlap structurally, and the method requires repeated gather/scatter and recomposition. So it will generally be slower than highly optimized kernels in the standard full-resident regime. The paper itself notes that overlap introduces redundancy, which suggests the experiments likely include time–memory trade-offs under different decomposition depths or different c/l choices. If there is an ablation over recursive depth, that is especially useful because it quantifies how much extra compute is paid for each step down in peak memory.

This paper is not about improving pretraining metrics directly; it is an enabling systems technique. When reading the experiments, pay special attention to whether both training and inference are supported, whether backward memory savings are substantial in practice, and whether the method composes well with existing kernels or activation checkpointing on real long-context models.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Begin with the introduction to lock in the problem setting: this is about the case where full QKV itself does not fit, not about standard attention-kernel optimization. That framing is essential for comparing it fairly against FlashAttention, ring-style methods, or sparse attention.

Then read the CQS Divide construction carefully. The most important thing to understand is where the condition c=l(l-1)+1 comes from and why the cyclic interest set guarantees exact one-time coverage of every chunk pair. Figure 1, Figure 2, and the c=7 worked example are the core of the paper. If that part is unclear, it is hard to trust the exactness claim later.

Next, read the forward and backward algorithms with one specific question in mind: how does the method preserve exact softmax? The answer is the separate accumulation of numerator and denominator before final normalization. That is the technical heart of the method. The appendix derivation is worth reading only if you plan to implement it.

Finally, focus on three experimental views: peak memory versus sequence length, runtime versus memory budget, and numerical agreement with full attention. For a quick evaluation of relevance, 30 minutes is enough. For implementation or integration into a long-context training stack, spend at least an hour on the decomposition and scheduling details. The most useful follow-up question is not whether it replaces existing kernels outright, but whether it can be combined with IO-aware kernels, activation recomputation, and sequence parallelism.

recommendation.zh: 不是又一个近似注意力，而是“精确 attention 的可调度分解”；先看分解等价性证明与显存-吞吐曲线，确认开销别把收益吃光。
recommendation.en: Not another approximate attention: it’s a schedulable decomposition for exact attention—read the equivalence proof and the memory-vs-throughput curves to see if overhead kills the win.

paper.title: PipeLive: Efficient Live In-place Pipeline Parallelism Reconfiguration for Dynamic LLM Serving

summary.core_problem: 一句话：在不停止线上推理服务的前提下，实现 LLM 推理的流水线并行（PP）配置“在线、原地（in-place）”重配置，并解决重配置过程中 GPU 内存饱和、KV cache 需要动态缩放/迁移且必须保持一致性的问题。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身不是方法贡献，但对“训练—评测—迭代”效率有间接价值：它把 PP 从静态离线配置推进到可随工作负载秒级变化的在线弹性，减少重启带来的分钟级 downtime 与 in-flight 请求损失。对研究团队而言，这类系统能力会影响大模型实验的在线评测吞吐、A/B 对比速度，以及多配置（不同并行度/不同 GPU 组合）快速切换的工程可行性。
summary.technical_approach:
基于 vLLM 做系统扩展，核心围绕“KV cache 可缩放 + 一致迁移 + 源/目标配置共存”的工程机制：
- 协调协议（coordination protocol）：在源配置持续服务时，安全地准备目标配置，编排权重加载、层映射变化、KV 迁移与切换时机，避免破坏正在进行的推理。
- KV cache 动态缩放：指出 vLLM/PageAttention 虽然按 block 组织 KV，但每层 KV 在 GPU 上通常预分配为连续大区间，无法原地 resize；直接做细粒度 block 分配会因 GPU 分配粒度更粗导致严重内部碎片。
- 非连续 KV block 访问：扩展 PageAttention 支持非连续块，从而允许 KV 以块为单位增长/收缩。
- Layer stacking：把多层的 KV 状态打包到一个分配单元中，使“逻辑 KV block”与 GPU 分配粒度对齐，降低碎片。
- KV patching：借鉴虚拟机热迁移（live migration）的思想，推理过程中增量迁移 KV，减少源/目标 KV 的差异，最后用很短的停顿完成收敛与一致切换，避免 stop-and-copy 的长暂停。

summary_en.core_problem: Enable live, in-place reconfiguration of pipeline parallelism for LLM serving—without stopping inference—despite GPUs being saturated by weights and KV cache, and despite the need to resize and migrate KV states consistently during the transition.
summary_en.importance: Not a pretraining-method paper, but it matters for research velocity and evaluation infrastructure: it turns pipeline-parallel inference from a static, restart-heavy setup into a workload-adaptive, elastic system that can react on second-level dynamics (heterogeneous GPUs, prefill-heavy vs decode-heavy shifts) with minimal disruption. This can reduce downtime and improve the practicality of rapid A/B evaluation and multi-configuration serving in foundation-model workflows.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Built on top of vLLM, the design centers on making KV cache resizable and migratable while keeping source and target PP configurations coexisting safely:
- A coordination protocol orchestrates weight loading, layer remapping, KV migration, and the final cutover while continuing to serve requests.
- KV resizing challenge: existing PageAttention-style systems often preallocate each layer’s KV as a contiguous region, which cannot be resized in place; naive block-level allocation is inefficient due to coarse GPU allocation granularity and internal fragmentation.
- Non-contiguous KV block access extends PageAttention to allow KV to be managed as blocks that can grow/shrink.
- Layer stacking packs multiple layers’ KV states into a single allocation unit to better match GPU allocation granularity and reduce fragmentation.
- KV patching (inspired by VM live migration) incrementally migrates KV during inference to keep divergence small, then reconciles the residual with a short final pause instead of a long stop-and-copy stall.

The introduction motivates the target benefits, but the key numbers require the later experimental figures/tables.

Skim plan:
- Read the Introduction to map the three core obstacles (memory saturation, KV resizing, KV-consistent migration) to the proposed components (15–20 min).
- Then focus on the design sections for non-contiguous KV access, layer stacking (memory layout + fragmentation reasoning), and KV patching/cutover protocol (30–45 min).

paper.title: Aethon: A Reference-Based Replication Primitive for Constant-Time Instantiation of Stateful AI Agents

summary.core_problem: 在“有状态 AI Agent”成为运行时基本单元后，现有系统普遍采用“显式物化（materialization）”来创建/复制 agent 实例：加载配置、绑定工具、重建记忆与运行态等，导致实例化延迟、内存与运维成本随“继承结构”线性增长，进而抑制多 agent 分解与按需分叉（one-user/one-task/多分支）等设计。论文要解决的是：如何提供一种运行时复制/实例化原语，使得新 agent 的创建对共享/继承结构呈常数时间，并在隔离性与可治理性上不退化。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身的直接贡献较弱（更偏 agent runtime/系统基础设施），但对“长上下文/外部记忆/持续交互”形态的落地有启发：当推理侧越来越依赖持久状态与多实例编排时，系统层的实例化与状态共享机制会反过来影响我们如何设计记忆表示、工具策略与可复用的“共享前缀/共享策略面”。对研究者的价值主要在于：提供一种把 agent 状态拆成“稳定共享层 + 局部增量层”的抽象，这个抽象与预训练里的参数共享、prefix/adapter、以及持续学习里的“基座+增量”范式在概念上同构，可用于启发更系统化的记忆/策略分层设计。
summary.technical_approach:
Aethon 的核心是“reference-based replication（基于引用的复制）”而非“完整物化”。论文论证：多数 agent 实例在结构层面高度相似（基础指令、工具能力、组织知识/约束等可共享），真正实例特有的只是少量局部状态。因此将实例定义为：对一组共享结构的引用 + 一组本地 delta（分层内存），并通过 copy-on-write 语义在写入时才分裂，从而把实例化成本从“复制全部结构”改为“创建一个可解析的身份/视图”。从全文可见其关键设计点在于：
1) 分层状态模型：把 agent 的“继承物”（role/policy/tool surface/共享知识）与“局部态”（会话历史、用户偏好、任务中间产物）分离；
2) 引用投影（projection）：实例在运行时按需解析为有效执行视图，而不是创建时一次性组装；
3) 隔离性：通过 layered memory + copy-on-write 保证不同实例对共享层只读、对局部层可写，避免相互污染；
4) 复制原语的语义定位：把“spawn/branch agent”变成平台级 primitive，使多 agent 编排不再被冷启动/物化成本绑架。
论文整体更像提出系统抽象与原语，而非给出可复现的完整实现细节；技术新意主要在于把 OS/存储领域常见的 COW/引用复制思想系统化映射到 agent runtime 的实例化与状态管理上。
summary.experiments: 在给定的全文片段中未出现可核验的系统实现细节、基准测试设置与具体数字（如实例化延迟、内存占用、吞吐提升、与传统 materialization 的对比曲线等）。因此无法基于“全文内容”提取参数量/数据规模/性能提升幅度等定量结论。若论文后续章节包含 microbenchmark（spawn latency vs. inherited state size）、多 agent 工作流端到端延迟、以及 COW 命中率/内存节省等，应重点核对其：对共享层规模的渐近行为是否真为常数、以及在高写入比例场景下是否退化。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 15–25 分钟）：
1) Introduction：抓住问题定义——为什么 materialization 会抑制多实例/多分支 agent 设计；
2) Background & Motivation：理解作者对“agent 运行时本体论”的判断（实例大多共享结构）；
3) 重点找“state 分层模型”“reference/projection 语义”“copy-on-write 隔离”三块的正式定义与示意图（若有）；
4) 若有 Evaluation：优先看实例化延迟随继承结构增长的曲线、内存占用拆分、以及在多 agent 编排下的端到端收益；同时留意写放大（频繁写导致 COW 分裂）是否被讨论。
对预训练研究者而言，建议带着“基座+增量（delta）”的视角阅读：哪些状态适合共享、哪些必须局部化、共享层如何版本化与治理。

summary_en.core_problem: As AI systems shift from stateless inference calls to persistent, stateful agents, the dominant instantiation pattern—full materialization (loading configs, binding tools, reconstructing memory/state)—incurs latency and memory costs that scale with inherited structure. This becomes a bottleneck for regimes like one-agent-per-user, one-agent-per-task, and dynamic multi-agent branching. The paper targets a runtime primitive that enables constant-time agent instantiation with respect to shared/inherited structure while preserving isolation.
summary_en.importance: Limited direct impact on foundation-model pretraining methods (it is primarily an agent runtime/systems paper), but it matters for how long-horizon, memory-heavy, multi-agent deployments are made practical. For pretraining researchers, the key transferable idea is the explicit decomposition of agent state into a stable shared layer plus per-instance deltas—conceptually aligned with base+adapter/prefix sharing and continual-learning base+increment paradigms. This framing can inform how we design reusable policy surfaces, shared memories, and versioned constraints that interact with LLMs at inference time.
summary_en.technical_approach: Aethon proposes reference-based replication instead of explicit materialization. The central claim is that most of what defines an agent instance is structurally shared (base instructions, tool capabilities, organizational constraints/knowledge), while only a small fraction is truly local (session history, user/task-specific state). The approach models an instance as a reference-oriented projection over shared structures plus local deltas, resolved on demand into an effective execution view. Isolation is maintained via layered memory and copy-on-write semantics: shared layers remain read-only, and writes trigger local divergence. The novelty is less about a new algorithm and more about elevating COW-style replication into a first-class runtime primitive for spawning/branching agents at scale.
summary_en.experiments: From the provided full-text portion, there are no extractable, verifiable quantitative results (e.g., instantiation latency, memory savings, throughput, or end-to-end workflow improvements) and no concrete experimental tables/figures to cite. If later sections include benchmarks, the critical checks are: (i) whether instantiation time is empirically flat vs. inherited-state size, (ii) memory breakdown and COW effectiveness, and (iii) degradation under high write rates where COW can collapse into full copies.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim plan (15–25 minutes): read the Introduction for the bottleneck argument against materialization; scan Background/Motivation for the “instances are mostly shared” premise; then locate the formal definition/diagram of the layered state model, projection semantics, and copy-on-write isolation. If an Evaluation section exists, prioritize plots of spawn latency vs. inherited structure size and memory savings, plus any discussion of worst-case write-heavy behavior. Read with a “base + delta” lens to map the runtime layering to analogous pretraining/continual-learning decompositions.

recommendation.zh: 偏系统但抽象很干净：把agent状态拆成共享基座+增量层，能反推你该如何设计可复用记忆/策略分层；读设计原语与隔离语义即可。
recommendation.en: More runtime than pretraining, but the “shared base + delta state” primitive is a clean mental model for reusable memory/policy layering; read the core primitive + isolation semantics.

paper.title: Why Smaller Is Slower? Dimensional Misalignment in Compressed LLMs

summary.core_problem: 后训练压缩（尤其是维度缩减：低秩分解/结构化剪枝等）虽然减少参数量与 FLOPs，却常导致张量维度变得“不规则”（如 128→107），触发 GPU 执行栈在框架调度、库实现与硬件层面的非最优路径，出现“模型更小但更慢”的反直觉现象。作者将其系统化命名为 dimensional misalignment（维度失配）。
summary.importance: 该论文把“压缩=更快”这一常见假设拆解为可诊断、可优化的系统问题：速度不仅由参数量决定，还由维度是否满足 GPU 对齐约束（Tensor Core tile、FlashAttention 对齐、cuBLAS kernel 选择等）决定。它提供了一个可迁移的范式 GAC：作为任何维度缩减压缩器的‘后处理包装器’，在不改变上游压缩算法的前提下恢复推理速度，并给出参数预算保证。
summary.technical_approach:
1) 全栈归因（framework/library/hardware 三层）：
- Framework：如 PyTorch 的算子分发（以 SDPA 为例）会因形状不满足条件而从 FlashAttention 等优化实现回退到 eager/naive 实现。
- Library：cuBLAS/cuBLASLt、Triton 等在不同维度下选择不同 kernel；不对齐会触发更差的 kernel 或额外开销。
- Hardware：Tensor Core 对矩阵维度/对齐有硬约束（常见如 8 对齐），不满足会导致吞吐显著下降。
2) GAC（GPU-Aligned Compression）：
- 输入：任意维度缩减压缩器给出的连续/不规则维度分配结果（由重要性分数 s_i 导出）。
- 目标：在相同参数预算 B 下，重新选择每层/每块的离散维度 d_i，使其满足对齐约束（如 d_i mod 8 = 0），同时尽量贴近原压缩器的“重要性分配意图”。
- 形式化：把维度选择写成带对齐约束的预算分配问题，并用动态规划（文中称 multi-choice knapsack/DP solver）求解以提供对齐与预算保证。
核心点是“压缩器无关”：GAC 不替代 ASVD/PaLU/剪枝等方法的打分逻辑，而是在维度落地时做硬件友好的再选择。
summary.experiments:
作者在 A100-80GB、PyTorch 2.9.1、CUDA 12.8、FP16 下做系统测量（CUDA events，多轮 warmup/测量）。关键发现与结果包括：
- 失配普遍性：ASVD 在 Llama-3-8B 上可出现约 95% 的维度失配；即便较粗粒度的 LLM-Pruner 也有约 17% 失配（文中以表格统计）。
- 失配代价：以 8 对齐为例，不对齐可导致最高约 90% 的延迟上升（文中以图示展示）。
- GAC 效果：在不牺牲精度的前提下，Llama-3-8B 上可获得最高约 1.5× 推理加速（相对未对齐的压缩模型），并解释其来自避免回退与更优 kernel 选择。
此外，论文用 PaLU 等真实压缩例子展示：参数减少但速度不增的现象来自维度失配而非压缩本身无效。
summary.reading_guide:
must_read（精读建议：详细技术分析路径）
- §2 Motivation / Dimensional Misalignment：先建立概念与现象，重点看 misalignment 的统计与“更小但更慢”的具体案例（如 Llama-3-8B + ASVD/PaLU）。
- §3 Full-Stack Analysis：全文技术含金量最高部分。按三层读：框架分发（SDPA/FlashAttention 回退条件）→ 库 kernel 选择（cuBLASLt/Triton）→ 硬件对齐（Tensor Core tile）。把每一层的“触发条件—后果—证据图”串起来。
- §4 GAC：重点理解其优化问题如何从连续维度变成离散对齐维度的 multi-choice knapsack，以及 DP 如何保证预算与对齐；关注它如何作为“wrapper”接入任意压缩器。
- §5 Evaluation：对照看速度恢复是否来自对齐而非其他 confound；优先看端到端 latency、算子级 breakdown、以及对齐比例变化。
- 重点图表：GEMM 维度示意（Figure 1）、misalignment 分布（Figure 2/3）、全栈归因图（Figure 4）、不对齐延迟惩罚（Figure 5）、以及速度提升汇总表。

skim（泛读建议：快速把握贡献）
- 读 Introduction + §2：理解“维度缩减→不规则维度→GPU 回退→变慢”的因果链。
- 快速扫 §3 的 Figure 4/5：抓住三层根因与不对齐的量化惩罚。
- 读 §4 的问题定义与算法概述：知道 GAC 是预算约束下的对齐维度重选（DP/knapsack）。
- 只看 §5 的端到端速度与精度结论（最高 1.5×）。
summary.authors_note: 作者刻意把问题从‘经验调参/黑盒 latency 优化’变成可解释的系统性根因分析，并强调与既有硬件感知方法的差异：不是针对特定网络/硬件做启发式搜索，而是给出对齐约束下的预算可行解（DP 保证）。写作上也强调“压缩器无关”的定位：GAC 是落地阶段的维度再选择，而非替换上游重要性评分。

summary_en.core_problem: Post-training compression—especially dimension reduction (low-rank factorization, structured pruning, etc.)—often produces irregular tensor dimensions (e.g., 128→107). These shapes are unfriendly to the GPU execution stack and can trigger backend fallbacks and suboptimal kernels, yielding the counterintuitive outcome that a smaller model runs no faster (or even slower). The paper formalizes this as dimensional misalignment.
summary_en.importance: The work challenges the common assumption that fewer parameters/FLOPs automatically translate to lower latency. It shows that GPU-aligned shapes are a first-class constraint (Tensor Core tiling, FlashAttention alignment, cuBLAS kernel selection). It introduces GAC, a compressor-agnostic paradigm that wraps any dimension-reducing compressor and re-selects hardware-aligned dimensions under the same parameter budget, restoring speed without sacrificing accuracy.
summary_en.technical_approach:
1) Full-stack root-cause analysis across three layers:
- Framework: operator dispatch (e.g., PyTorch SDPA) may fall back from optimized implementations (FlashAttention) to naive/eager paths when shapes violate constraints.
- Library: cuBLAS/cuBLASLt/Triton choose different kernels depending on dimensions; misalignment can force slower kernels or extra overhead.
- Hardware: Tensor Cores impose alignment/tile constraints (commonly 8-alignment); violating them reduces throughput.
2) GAC (GPU-Aligned Compression):
- Input: an upstream compressor’s continuous/irregular per-layer dimension allocations derived from importance scores.
- Goal: under the same parameter budget B, re-select discrete per-layer dimensions that satisfy alignment constraints (e.g., d mod 8 = 0) while preserving the compressor’s intended budget distribution.
- Formulation/solver: cast dimension selection as a constrained multi-choice knapsack and solve via dynamic programming to guarantee both budget and alignment.
Key property: compressor-agnostic—GAC does not change the upstream scoring/compression logic; it fixes the deployment-facing dimension choices.
summary_en.experiments:
On A100-80GB with PyTorch 2.9.1, CUDA 12.8, FP16 (CUDA-event timing), the paper shows:
- Prevalence: ASVD on Llama-3-8B can yield ~95% misaligned dimensions; even coarse LLM-Pruner leaves ~17% misalignment.
- Cost: with 8-alignment as an example, misalignment can increase latency by up to ~90%.
- Benefit: GAC restores performance, achieving up to ~1.5× speedup on Llama-3-8B without accuracy loss, largely by avoiding fallbacks and enabling better kernel choices.
Real compressor case studies (e.g., PaLU) illustrate that “smaller but not faster” is driven by misalignment rather than compression being inherently ineffective.
summary_en.reading_guide:
must_read (deep technical reading)
- §2 Motivation: internalize the phenomenon with concrete stats/cases (e.g., Llama-3-8B + ASVD/PaLU) and the misalignment definition.
- §3 Full-Stack Analysis: the most valuable section—follow the chain framework dispatch → library kernel selection → hardware alignment, and map each to its triggering conditions and measured evidence.
- §4 GAC: understand the constrained optimization (multi-choice knapsack) and why DP provides budget/alignment guarantees; focus on how it wraps arbitrary compressors.
- §5 Evaluation: verify end-to-end latency gains, operator-level breakdowns, and alignment ratio changes; ensure gains are attributable to alignment.
- Key figures/tables: GEMM dimension schematic (Fig. 1), misalignment distributions (Fig. 2/3), root-cause overview (Fig. 4), latency penalty vs alignment (Fig. 5), and the main speedup table.

skim (fast understanding)
- Read Introduction + §2 for the causal story: dimension reduction → irregular shapes → GPU fallbacks → slower.
- Skim Fig. 4/5 in §3 to capture the three-layer causes and quantified penalty.
- Read §4’s formulation at a high level: budgeted, alignment-constrained dimension re-selection via DP.
- Check §5 headline results: up to ~1.5× speedup with no accuracy drop.
summary_en.authors_note: The paper deliberately turns a black-box latency issue into an explainable systems problem, and differentiates from prior hardware-aware work by providing a constraint-based solution with guarantees (DP under a fixed parameter budget). It also emphasizes the ‘wrapper’ positioning: GAC is deployment-oriented dimension re-selection, not a replacement for upstream importance scoring.

recommendation.zh: 作为系统备查很值但不必细读：记住“不对齐维度会掉进慢 kernel”，需要时直接套它的对齐后处理（GAC）救速度。
recommendation.en: Worth knowing as a systems reference, not a deep read: remember “misaligned dims trigger slow kernels,” and use their alignment post-process (GAC) when compression makes models slower.

paper.title: SpecMoE: A Fast and Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Inference via Self-Assisted Speculative Decoding

summary.core_problem: 解决MoE推理部署中的高显存/带宽开销与吞吐受限问题，尤其在内存受限与CPU-offload场景下实现更高效的MoE推理。
summary.importance: 贡献类型为推理系统创新：将speculative decoding引入MoE推理且无需额外训练/微调，面向部署痛点（显存、内存/互连带宽）给出可落地加速方案；对MoE大模型工程与高效推理有直接价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出SpecMoE：基于“self-assisted speculative decoding”的MoE推理框架，在不训练额外draft模型/不微调的前提下进行推测解码以减少昂贵MoE计算与数据搬运；系统层面优化内存与互连带宽占用，适配内存受限平台与较大batch推理。
summary.experiments: 报告吞吐最高提升约4.30×，并显著降低内存与互连带宽需求；摘要未给出具体MoE模型规模、硬件配置、对比系统（如CPU-offloaded MoE基线）与不同batch/序列长度下的细分结果（需看正文）。

summary_en.core_problem: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) inference is often bottlenecked by high memory/bandwidth costs and limited throughput, particularly under memory-constrained deployment and CPU-offload settings.
summary_en.importance: The paper introduces a practical inference-system technique that brings speculative decoding to MoE without extra training, targeting real deployment pain points (GPU memory, host-device/interconnect bandwidth) to accelerate MoE serving.
summary_en.technical_approach: SpecMoE uses self-assisted speculative decoding to reduce expensive MoE computation and data movement without training a separate draft model or fine-tuning; it additionally incorporates system optimizations to lower memory and interconnect bandwidth usage and to support larger-batch inference on constrained platforms.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports up to about 4.30× throughput improvement and substantial reductions in memory and interconnect bandwidth demand, but omits detailed model sizes, hardware configurations, baselines, and breakdowns across batch/sequence regimes.

recommendation.zh: 把 speculative decoding 套到 MoE 推理且不改训练，适合当部署技巧备查；重点看在 CPU-offload/带宽受限下是否真能稳住收益。
recommendation.en: A practical deployment trick: speculative decoding for MoE without retraining; keep it as a reference and focus on whether gains persist under CPU-offload / bandwidth-bound settings.

paper.title: A-IO: Adaptive Inference Orchestration for Memory-Bound NPUs

summary.core_problem: 解决LLM在异构NPU平台部署时，自回归解码阶段因内存带宽/同步开销导致吞吐与延迟受限、且静态单模型部署出现“模型缩放悖论”的问题。
summary.importance: 工程与系统层面的推理效率研究：指出在NPU编译/计算图约束下，现有细粒度speculative decoding与微观加速（如PLD）可能失效或收益受限，并提出需要“自适应推理编排”的新视角来应对memory-bound瓶颈。
summary.technical_approach: 提出A-IO（Adaptive Inference Orchestration）面向memory-bound NPU的自适应推理编排框架：不再静态固定单一尺寸模型，而是根据平台特性与运行态瓶颈在模型/策略层面做动态调度；同时分析细粒度speculative decoding在NPU图编译下的kernel同步开销，主张更粗粒度、编排式的推理优化路径（具体编排策略与实现细节以论文为准）。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集、对比基线与量化提升；仅提到目标平台示例为Ascend 910B，并对speculative decoding与PLD类方法在该类平台的局限进行分析。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM decoding on heterogeneous NPUs can become memory-bandwidth and synchronization bound, leading to limited throughput/latency improvements and even a “model scaling paradox” under static single-model deployment; the challenge is to orchestrate inference adaptively under these constraints.
summary_en.importance: The work highlights that common fine-grained inference accelerations (including speculative decoding variants) may underperform on NPUs due to graph compilation and kernel synchronization overheads. It motivates a system-level, platform-aware orchestration perspective for achieving reliable gains on memory-bound accelerators.
summary_en.technical_approach: A-IO (Adaptive Inference Orchestration) proposes dynamically scheduling among model/strategy choices rather than fixing one model size, adapting to platform characteristics and runtime bottlenecks. The paper analyzes why fine-grained speculative decoding and related micro-optimizations can be limited on compiled NPU graphs and argues for coarser-grained, orchestration-driven optimization.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract references Ascend 910B as a target platform and discusses limitations of speculative decoding and PLD-like approaches there, but does not provide concrete model sizes, datasets, baselines, or quantitative improvements.

recommendation.zh: 对 NPU 上 memory-bound 解码的提醒比方法更有用：很多细粒度 SD/小技巧在编译约束下失效；只看“模型缩放悖论”与编排策略。
recommendation.en: The key value is the warning: on memory-bound NPUs, many fine-grained SD tricks collapse under compiler constraints; skim the “scaling paradox” and orchestration policy.

paper.title: Watt Counts: Energy-Aware Benchmark for Sustainable LLM Inference on Heterogeneous GPU Architectures

summary.core_problem: 缺少可复现、可对比的能耗评测与数据，导致LLM推理部署难以在异构GPU上做能效最优决策。
summary.importance: Benchmark/数据贡献：提供大规模开放能耗数据集与可扩展基准，直接服务LLM推理系统与可持续计算；对“硬件-模型-场景”能效权衡给出系统性证据。
summary.technical_approach: 发布Watt Counts：包含>5,000次实验、覆盖50个LLM、10种NVIDIA GPU，涵盖batch与server两类场景；提供可复现的开源benchmark并支持社区提交扩展；基于数据做系统层面对比分析，归纳不同模型/场景下GPU选择对能效的影响。
summary.experiments: 数据规模：50 LLM × 10 GPU × >5,000 runs；场景：batch与server；结论：最优GPU选择随模型与部署场景显著变化（摘要未给出具体指标提升幅度/统计细节）。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM inference deployment lacks reproducible, comparable energy measurements, making it difficult to choose energy-optimal configurations across heterogeneous GPUs.
summary_en.importance: The paper contributes an open benchmark and large-scale energy dataset that supports systematic, sustainable inference research and provides evidence for hardware–model–workload energy trade-offs in real deployments.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces Watt Counts, an open, reproducible benchmarking suite and dataset, and enables community extensions. Using the collected measurements, the authors analyze how energy efficiency varies with model choice, GPU type, and deployment scenario.
summary_en.experiments: The dataset includes >5,000 runs spanning 50 LLMs and 10 NVIDIA GPUs, evaluated in both batch and server scenarios. The main finding is that the energy-optimal GPU choice depends strongly on the model and serving setting; the abstract does not provide detailed effect sizes.

recommendation.zh: 作为能耗数据与基准备查很够用，但对预训练研究增量有限；需要时只翻数据集覆盖范围、测量方法和几张能效对比图。
recommendation.en: Useful as a reference benchmark/dataset for energy numbers, but little direct pretraining insight; skim the measurement methodology, coverage, and the key efficiency comparison figures.
